Arakhin 14b:23-15a:4: Gemara ammay? ema: "chamishshim selaim" amar rachamana mikkol mille!
Amar rav zeera: yomru, baal bat melachim chamishshim, baal bat hedyotot chamishshim?
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name, yomru: eved nokev margalit — sheloshim, eved ose maase machat — sheloshim? ella amar rav zeera:
Illu bau aleha shenayim, echad shello kedarkah veechad kedarkah, yomru: baal peguma — chamishshim, baal shelema — chamishshim?
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name yomru: eved bari — sheloshim, eved mukke shechin — sheloshim!
Ella amar abbaye, amar kera "tachat asher innah", mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam.
Rava amar, deamar kera: "venatan haish hashshochev immah vegomer", hanaat shechiva chamishshim, mikkelal deikka milleta achariti, umay nihu? boshet ufegam.
Beitzah 32a:15-32b:6: Veen osin pechamin. peshita, lemay chaze? tane rabbi chiyyay: lo nitzrecha ella lemosran leolyayrin levo bayyom.
Uvo bayyom mi shere? kidamar rava: lehazzia, vekodem gezera. hacha name: lehazzia, vekodem gezera.
Veen chotchin et happetila lishnayim. may shena besakkin dela —

Dekamtakken mana, baur name ka metakken mana! tane rabbi chiyyay: chotchah baur befi shete nerot. amar rav natan bar abba amar rav: mochatin et happetila beyom tov. may "mochatin"? amar rav chanina bar shelemya (mishshemeh derav): leaddoye chushecha.

Tane bar kappara: shishsha devarim neemru biftila. shelosha lehachemir, ushelosha lehakel. lehachemir: en godlin otah lechattechilla beyom tov, veen mehavehavin otah baur, veen chotchin otah lishnayim. lehakel: memaachah bayyad, veshorah beshemen, vechotchah baur befi shete nerot.
Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav: attire bavel, yorde gehinnam hem. ki ha deshabbetay bar marinus ikkela levavel, bea minnayyhu iska — vela yehavu leh. mezone mezan — name la zaynuhu.

Amar: hane meerev rav ka atu, dichtiv: "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha", kol hamerachem al habberiyyot — beyadua shehu mizzaro shel avraham avinu, vechol mi sheeno merachem al habberiyyot — beyadua sheeno mizzaro shel avraham avinu.

Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav: kol hametzappe al shulchan acherim — olam chashach baado, shenneemar: "noded hu lallechem ayye yada ki nachon beyado yom choshech". rav chisda amar: af chayyav enan chayyim.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha chayyehen enam chayyim, veellu hen: hametzappe leshulchan chavero, umi sheishto moshelet alav, umi sheyyissurin moshlin begufo. veyesh omrim: af mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad. vetanna kamma: efshar dimayyen bemaneh.
Berakhot 62a:2-6: Tanya, ben azzay omer: paam achat nichnasti achar rabbi akiva levet hakkisse, velamadti mimmennu shelosha devarim: lamadti sheen nifnin mizrach umaarav ella tzafon vedarom, velamadti sheen nifrain meummad ella meyushshav, velamadti sheen mekannechin beyamin ella bismol. amar lo rabbi yehuda: ad kan heazta panecha berabbecha?! amar lo: tora hi, velilmod ani tzarich.

Rav kahana al, gena tuteh pureyeh derav. shameh desach vesachak veasa tzerachav. amar leh: dame pummeh deabba kidla saref tavshila. amar leh: kahana, hacha at? pok, delav orach ara. amar leh: tora hi, velilmod ani tzarich.

Mippene ma en mekannechin beyamin ella bismol? amar rava: mippene shehattora nittena beyamin, shenneemar: "mimino esh dat lamo". rabba bar bar chana amar: mippene shehi kerova lappe. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mippene shekkosher bah tefillin. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mippene shemmare bah taame tora.
Ketannae. rabbi eliezer omer: mippene sheochel bah. rabbi yehoshua omer: mippene shekkotev bah. rabbi akiva omer: mippene shemmare bah taame tora.

Mishnah Chagigah 1:1-2:
Hakkol chayyavin bariyya, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan, vetumtum, veanderoginos, venashim, vaavadim sheenam meshuchrarim, hachigger, vehassuma, vehachole, vehazzaken, umi sheeno yachol laalot beraglav. ezehu katan, kol sheeno yachol lirkov al ketefav shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, divre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, kol sheeno yachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, shenneemar (Shemot 23) shalosh regalim: 
Bet shammay omrim, hariyya shete chesef, vachagiga maa chesef. uvet hillel omrim, hariyya maa chesef, vachagiga shete chasef:
Mishnah Chagigah 1:3-6:
Olot bammoed baot min hachullin, vehashshelamim min hammaaser. yom tov rishon shel pesach, bet shammay omrim, min hachullin, uvet hillel omrim, min hammaaser: 
Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim unedavot uvemasar behema, vehakkohanim bachattaot uvaashamot uvabbechor uvechaze vashok, aval lo vaofot velo vammenachot: 
Mi sheyyesh lo ochlim merubbim unechasim muatim, mevi shelamim merubbim veolot muatot. nechasim merubbim veochlin muatin, mevi olot merubbot ushelamim muatin. ze vaze muat, al ze neemar, maa chesef ushete chasef. ze vaze merubbim, al ze neemar (Devarim 16) ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach: 
Mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag, chogeg et kol haregel veyom tov haacharon shel chag. avar haregel velo chag, eno chayyav beacharayuto. al ze neemar (Kohelet 1) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon, vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot:
Mishnah Menachot 1:1-4:
Kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman, kesherot, ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova, chutz mimminchat chote, uminchat kenaot. minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman, natan bakkeli, vehillech, vehiktir shello lishman, o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman, pesulot. ketzad lishman veshello lishman, leshem minchat chote uleshem minchat nedava, o shello lishman velishman, leshem minchat nedava uleshem minchat chote: 
Achat minchat chote veachat kol hammenachot shekkematzan zar, onen, tevul yom, mechussar begadim, mechussar kippurim, shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe chelim, al gabbe vehema, al gabbe ragle chavero, pasal. kamatz bismol, pasal. ben betera omer, yachazir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin. kamatz veala veyado tzeror o gargir melach o koret shel levona, pasal, mippene sheamru, hakkometz hayyater vehechaser, pasul. eze hu hayyater, shekkematzo mevoratz. vechaser, shekkematzo verashe etzbeotav. ketzad hu ose, poshet et etzbeotav al pas yado: 
Ribba shamnah, vechissar shamnah, chissar levonatah, pesula. hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha vachutz, o chazzayit mishsheyareha vachutz, lehaketir kumtzah bachutz, o chazzayit mikkumtzah bachutz, o lehaketir levonatah bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. leechol sheyareha lemachar, o chazzayit mishsheyareha lemachar, lehaketir kumtzah lemachar, o chazzayit mikkumtzah lemachar, o lehaketir levonatah lemachar, piggul vechayyavin alav karet. ze hakkelal, kol hakkometz, vehannoten bichli, vehamehallech, vehammaktir, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. kamatz bishtika venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir bishtika, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato: 
Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. kamatz chutz limkomo, venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz limkomo, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz limkomo, minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmannan, o shekkamatz chutz lizmannan, venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir shello lishman, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir shello lishman, ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato. leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze pasul veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:
Mishnah Menachot 2:1-4:
Hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaketir kumtzah lemachar, mode rabbi yose baze, shehu figgul vechayyavin alav karet. lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer, pasul veen bo charet, vachachamim omrim, pigul vechayyavin alav karet. amru lo, ma shana zo min hazzavach. amar lahem, shehazzevach damo uvesaro veemurav echad, ulevona enah min hammincha: 
Shachat shene chevasim leechol achat min hachallot lemachar, hiktir shene vezichin leechol achad min hassedarim lemachar, rabbi yose omer, otah hachalla veoto hasseder shechishshav alav, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, vehashsheni pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze piggul vechayyavin alav karet. nitmet achat min hachallot o achad min hassedarim, rabbi yehuda omer, shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, sheen karban tzibbur chaluk. vachachamim omrim, hattame vetumato, vehattahor yeachel: 
Hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hattoda. ketzad. hashshochet et hattoda leechol mimmenna lemachar, hi vehallechem mefuggalin. leechol min hallechem lemachar, hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggalet. hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim. ketzad. hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol mehem lemachar, hem vehallechem mefuggalim. leechol min hallechem lemachar, hallechem mefuggal, vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin: 
Hazzevach mefaggel et hannesachin mishshekkadshu vichli, divre rabbi meir. vehannesachin enan mefaggelin et hazzavach. ketzad. hashshochet et hazzevach leechol mimmennu lemachar, hu unesachav mefuggalin. lehakeriv min hannesachin lemachar, hannesachin mefuggalin, vehazzevach eno mefuggal:
Mishnah Menachot 2:5-3:3:
Piggel bakkometz velo vallevona, ballevona velo vakkometz, rabbi meir omer, piggul vechayyavin alav karet. vachachamim omrim, en bo charet, ad sheyyefaggel et kol hammattir. modim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uveminchat kenaot, sheim piggel bakkometz, shehu figgul vechayyavin alav karet, shehakkometz hu hammattir. shachat achad min hakkevasim leechol shete challot lemachar, hiktir achad min habbezichim leechol shene sedarim lemachar, rabbi meir omer, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. vachachamim omrim, en piggul, ad sheyyefaggel et kol hammattir. shachat achad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar, hu figgul, vachavero chasher. leechol mechavero lemachar, shenehem kesherim: 
Hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol, lehaketir davar sheen darko lehaketir, kasher. rabbi eliezer posel. leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, pachot mikkazzayit, kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin: 
Lo yatzak, lo valal, lo fatat, lo malach, lo henif, lo higgish, o sheppetatan pittim merubbot, velo meshachan, kesherot. nitarev kumtzah bekometz chavertah, beminchat kohanim, beminchat kohen hammashiach, beminchat nesachin, keshera. rabbi yehuda omer, beminchat kohen hammashiach uveminchat nesachin, pesula, shezzo belilatah ava, vezo belilatah rakka, vehen bolot zo mizzo: 
Shete menachot shello nikmetzu, venitarvu zo vazo, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah, kesherot. veim lav, pesulot. hakkometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza, lo yaktir. veim hiktir, zo shennikmetza, alta labbealim, vezo shello nikmetza, lo alta labbealim. nitarev kumtzah bishyareha o vishyareha shel chavertah, lo yaktir. veim hiktir, alta labbealim. nitma hakkometz vehikrivo, hatztzitz meratztze. yatza vehikrivo, en hatztzitz meratztze, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, veeno meratztze al hayyotze:
Mishnah Menachot 3:4-4:1:
Nitmeu sheyareha, nisrefu sheyareha, avdu sheyareha, kemiddat rabbi eliezer, keshera. uchemiddat rabbi yehoshua, pesula. shello vichli sharet, pesula. rabbi shimon machshir. hiktir kumtzah paamayim, keshera: 
Hakkometz, miuto meakkev et rubbo. haissaron, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hayyayin, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hashshemen, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze. hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze: 
Shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze. shene chivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze. shete challot meakkevot zo et zo. shene sedarim meakkevin ze et ze. shene vezichin meakkevin ze et ze. hassedarim vehabbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. shene minim shebbannazir, shelosha shebbappara, arbaa shebbattoda, arbaa shebballulav, arbaa shebbammetzora, meakkevin ze et ze. sheva hazzayot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo. sheva hazzayot shel ben habbaddim, vesheal happarochet, vesheal mizbach hazzahav, meakkevot zo et zo: 
Shiva kene menora meakkevin ze et ze. shiva neroteha meakkevin ze et ze. shete farashiyyot shebbammezuza meakkevot zo et zo. vaafillu chetav echad meakkevan. arba parashiyyot shebbattefillin meakkevot zo et zo. vaafillu chetav echad meakkevan. arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo, shearbatan mitzva echat. rabbi yishmael omer, arbatan arba mitzvot: 
Hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan, vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet. tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh, veshel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad. hassolet vehashshemen enam meakkevin et hayyayin, velo hayyayin meakkevan. hammattanot sheal mizbeach hachitzon enan meakkevot zo et zo:
Mishnah Moed Katan 1:10-2:3:
Osin maake legag ulemirpeset maase hedyot, aval lo maase umman. shafin et hassedakin umagilin otan bammagila bayyad uvaregel, aval lo vammachalatzayim. hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu, metakkenan bammoed, uvilvad shello yechavven melachto bammoed, vechol kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed, kovshan: 
Mi shehafach et zetav veero evel o ones, o shehituhu foalim, toen kora rishona umannichah leachar hammoed. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko: 
Vechen mi shehaya yeno betoch habbor veero evel o ones, o shehituhu foalim, zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer, ose lo limmudim, bishvil shello yachmitz: 
Machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim, veshole fishtano min hammishra bishvil shello tovad, uvilvad shello yechavven et melachto vammoed. vechullan im kivvenu melachtan bammoed, yovedu:
Mishnah Moed Katan 1:5-9:
Rabbi meir omer, roin et hannegaim battechilla lehakel, aval lo lehachemir. vachachamim omrim, lo lehakel velo lehachemir. veod amar rabbi meir, melakket adam atzmot aviv veimmo, mippene shessimcha hi lo. rabbi yose omer, evel hu lo. lo yeorer adam al meto velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom: 
En chofrin kuchin ukevarot bammoed, aval mechannechim et hakkuchin bammoed. veosin nivrechet bammoed, vearon im hammet bechatzer. rabbi yehuda oser, ella im ken yesh immo nesarim: 
En nosin nashim bammoed, lo vetulot, velo almanot, velo meyabbemin, mippene shessimcha hi lo. aval machazir hu et gerushato. veosa ishsha tachshiteha vammoed. rabbi yehuda omer, lo tasud mippene shenniuul hu lah: 
Hahedyot tofer kedarko, vehaumman machliv. umesargin et hammittot. rabbi yose omer, af memattechin: 
Maamidin tannur vechirayim verechayim bammoed. rabbi yehuda omer, en mechabbeshin et harechayim battechilla:
Mishnah Moed Katan 2:4-3:2:
En lokchin battim, avadim uvehema, ella letzorech hammoed, o letzorech hammocher, sheen lo ma yochol. en mefannin mibbayit levayit, aval mefanne hu lachatzero. en meviin kelim mibbet haumman. veim choshesh lahem, mefannan lechatzer acheret: 
Mechappin et hakketziot bekash. rabbi yehuda omer, af meabbin. mochre ferot, kesut vechelim, mochrim betzina letzorech hammoed. hatztzayyadin vehaddashoshot vehaggarosot, osin betzina letzorech hammoed. rabbi yose omer, hem hechmiru al atzman: 
Veellu megallechin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam, umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurin, vehamenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar, vehannazir, vehammetzora haole mittumato letohorato: 
Veellu mechabbesin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam, umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurim, vehamenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar, mitpechot hayyadayim umitpechot hassapparim umitpechot hassefag, hazzavin vehazzavot vehanniddot vehayyoldot, vechol haolin mittuma letohora, hare ellu muttarin. ushear kol adam, asurin:
Mishnah Moed Katan 3:3-7:
Veellu kotvin bammoed, kiddushe nashim, gittin veshovarin, deyateke, mattana uferozbulin, iggerot shum veiggerot mazon, shitre chalitza umeunim, veshitre verurin, ugezerot bet din, veiggerot shel rashut: 
En kotvin shitre chov bammoed. veim eno maamino o sheen lo ma yochal, hare ze yichtov. en kotvin sefarim, tefillin umezuzot, bammoed, veen maggihin ot achat, afillu besefer (haazara) ezra. rabbi yehuda omer, kotev adam tefillin umezuzot leatzmo, vetove al yerecho techelet letzitzito: 
Hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel, batla hemennu gezerat shiva. shemona, batla hemennu gezerat sheloshim, mippene sheamru, shabbat ola veenah mafseket, regalim mafsikin veenan olin: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, atzeret keshabbat. rabban gamliel omer, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, kargalim. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella atzeret kargalim, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim keshabbat: 
En korin, velo choltzin, veen mavrin, ella kerovav shel met, veen mavrin ella al mitta zekufa. en molichin levet haevel lo betavla velo veiskutela velo vekanon, ella vesallim. veen omrim birkat avelim bammoed, aval omdin beshura umenachamin ufotrin et harabbim:
Mishnah Moed Katan 3:8-9:
En mannichin et hammitta barchov, shello leharegil et hahesped, velo shel nashim leolam, mippene hakkavod. nashim bammoed meannot, aval lo metappechot. rabbi yishmael omer, hassemuchot lammitta, metappechot: 
Berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim, meannot, umetappechot baze uvaze, aval lo mekonnot. nikbar hammet, lo meannot velo metappechot. ezehu innuy, shekkullan onot keechat. kina, sheachat medabberet vechullan onot achareha, shenneemar (yirmeya 9), velammedna venotechem nehi, veishsha reutah kina. aval leatid lavo hu omer (yeshaya ko), billa hammavet lanetzach, umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer:
Mishnah Zavim 1:5-2:2:
Raa achat merubba cheshalosh, shehi chemin gad yon lashshiloach, shehen kede shete tevilot vechishne sippugin, hare ze zav gamur. raa achat merubba chishtayim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. amar rabbi yose, lo amru achat merubba ella im ken yesh bah kede shalosh: 
Raa achat hayyom veachat ben hashshemashot, achat ben hashshemashot veachat lemachar, im yadua shemmiktzat hariyya mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar, vadday lakkarban velattuma. im safek shemmiktzat hariyya mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar, vadday lattuma vesafek lakkarban. raa shene yamim ben hashshemashot, safek lattuma velakkarban. achat ben hashshemashot, safek lattuma: 
Hakkol mittammein beziva, af haggerim, af haavadim, ben meshuchrarin ben sheenan meshuchrarin, cheresh, shote, vekatan, seris adam, seris chamma. tumtum veanderoginos, notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha, mittammein bedam kaishsha uveloven kaish, vetumatan besafek: 
Beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak leziva. bemaachol, bemishte, uvemassa, bikfitza, becholi, uvemare uvehirhur. hirher ad shello raa o sheraa ad shello hirher. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu raa vehema, chayya vaof mitassekin ze im ze, afillu raa vigde tzeva haishsha. rabbi akiva omer, afillu achal kol maachol, ben ra ben yafe, veshata chol mashke. amru lo, en kan zavin meatta. amar lahem, en acharayut zavim alechem. mishshennizkak leziva, en bodkin oto. anso usefeko veshichvat zaro temeim, sheraglayim laddavar. raa reiyya rishona, bodkin oto. bashsheniyya, bodkin oto. bashshelishit, en bodkin oto. rabbi eliezer omer, af bashshelishit bodkin oto, mippene hakkarban:
Mishnah Zavim 2:3-3:3:
Haroe keri, eno mittamme veziva meet leet. rabbi yose omer, yomo. nachri sheraa keri venitgayyer, miyyad hu mittamme veziva. haroa dam vehammaksha, meet leet. vehammakke et avdo yom yomayim, meet leet. kelev sheachal besar hammet, shelosha yamim meet leet, hare hu chivriyyato: 
Hazzav metamme et hammishkav bachamishsha derachim, letamme adam letamme vegadim. omed, yoshev, shochev, nitle venishan. vehammishkav metamme et haadam beshiva derachim letamme vegadim. omed, yoshev, shochev, nitle, venishan, bemagga uvemassa: 
Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu visfina o veasda o sherachvu al gabbe vehema, af al pi sheen bigdehem nogim, hare ellu temeim midras. yashvu al hanneser, al hassafsal, al haggashish shel mitta veal haachlonas, bizman shehen machgirin, alu veilan shekkocho ra, besocha shekkochah ra, beilan yafe, besullam mitzri bizman sheeno kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh veal hakkora veal haddelet bizman sheen asuyin betit, temeim. rabbi yehuda metaher: 
Megifin o fotchin. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe ze megif veze foteach. maalin ze et ze min habbor. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyehe hattahor maale et hattame. mafshilin bachavalin. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye ze moshech helech veze moshech helech. orgim, ben beomdin ben beyoshvin o tochanin. rabbi shimon metaher bechullan, chutz min hattochanin berechayim shel yad. porkin min hachamor o toanin, bizman shemmassaam kaved, temein. bizman shemmasaam kal, tehorin. vechullan tehorin livne hakkeneset utemein latteruma: 
Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu visfina gedola, ezo hi sefina gedola. rabbi yehuda omer, kol sheenah yechola lehamit baadam. yashvu al hanneser, al hassafsal, al haggashish shel mitta veal haachlonas bizman sheenan machgirin, alu veilan shekkocho yafe, besocha shekkochah yafe, uvesullam tzori o mitzri bizman shehu kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh, al hakkora veal haddelet bizman shehen asuyin betit afillu mitztzad echad, tehorin. hattahor makke et hattame, tahor. hattame makke et hattahor, tame, sheim yimmashech hattahor, hare hattame nofel:
Mishnah Zavim 4:1-4:
Rabbi yehoshua omer, nidda sheyyashva im hattehora bemitta, kippa shebberoshah tame midras. yashva visfina, kelim shebberosh hannes shebbassefina temein midras. notelet areva melea vegadim, bizman shemmassaan kaved, temein. bizman shemmassaan kal, tehorin. zav shehikkish al ketzotzra, venafal kikkar shel teruma, tahor: 
Hikkish al hammarish, al hammalben, al hatztzinnor, veal haddaf, af al pi shehu asuy bachavalim, al hattannur, veal hayyam, veal itzterubbal, veal chamor shel rechayim shel yad, veal sea shel rechayim shel zetim, rabbi yose omer, af al korat habballanin, tahor: 
Hikkish al haddelet, al hanneger, al hammanul, al hammashot, veal hakkelet, veal ilan shekkocho ra, veal socha shekkochah ra, al ilan yafe, al sullam mitzri bizman sheeno kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh, al hakkora veal haddelet bizman sheenan asuyin betit, temein. al hashshidda, al hatteva veal hammigdal, temein. rabbi nechemya verabbi shimon metaharin baellu: 
Zav shehaya muttal al chamishsha safsalim o al chamesh pundiyyot, learkan, temein. lerachban, tehorin. yashen, safek shennithappech alehen, temein. haya muttal al shishsha chisyot, shete yadav al shenayim, shete raglav al shenayim, rosho al echad, gufo al echad, en tame ella ze shettachat hagguf. omed al shene chisot, rabbi shimon omer, im rechokin ze mizze, tehorin:
Mishnah Zavim 4:5-5:1:
Eser talliyyot zo al gav zo, yashen al gabbe haelyona, kullan temeot. hazzav bechaf moznayim umishkav umoshav kenegdo, kara hazzav, tehorin. karu hen, temein. rabbi shimon omer, bichidi, tame. uvimrubbin, tahor, sheen echad nose et rubbo: 
Hazzav bechaf moznayim veochalin umashkin bechaf sheniyya, temein. uvammet, hakkol tahor, chutz min haadam. ze chomer bazzav mibbammet. chomer bammet mibbazzav, shehazzav ose mishkav umoshav mittachtav letamme adam uletamme vegadim, veal gabbav maddaf letamme ochalin umashkin, ma sheen hammet metamme. chomer bammet, shehammet metamme veohel umetamme tumat shiva, ma sheen hazzav metamme: 
Haya yoshev al gabbe hammitta vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle hammitta, temeot, mippene sheenah yechola laamod al shalosh. rabbi shimon metaher. haya rochev al gabbe vehema vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle vehema, tehorot, mippene shehi yechola laamod al shelosha. hayta tallit achat tachat shene yadayim, tachat shene raglayim, tachat yad varegel, temea. rabbi yose omer, hassus metamme veraglav vehachamor beyadav, shemmishenet hassus al raglav umishenet hachamor al yadav. yashav al korat bet habbad, kelim shebbaekel temein. al hammachbesh shel koves, kelim shettachtav, tehorin. rabbi nechemya metamme: 
Hannogea bazzav o shehazzav noge bo, hammassit et hazzav o shehazzav massito, metamme ochalim umashkim uchele shetef bemagga, aval lo vemassa. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao, metamme ochalim umashkin lihyot techilla, vehayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, veeno metamme lo adam velo chele cheres. leachar perishato mimmetammeav, metamme mashkin lihyot techilla, vehoochalin vehayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, veeno metamme vegadim:
Mishnah Zavim 5:2-6:
Veod kelal acher amru. kol hannissa al gabbe hazzav, tame. vechol shehazzav nissa alav, tahor, chutz min harauy lemishkav ulemoshav vehaadam. ketzad. etzbao shel zav tachat hannidbach, hattahor milmalan, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad. hattame milmalan vehattahor millemattan, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metame echad ufosel echad. hoochalin vehammashkin, hammishkav, vehammoshav vehammaddaf milmalan, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. pershu, metammein echad ufoslin echad. vehammishkav vehammoshav millemattan, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. pershu, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. hoochalin vehammashkin vehammaddaf millemattan, tehorin: 
Mippene sheamru, kol hannose venissa al gabbe mishkav, tahor, chutz min haadam. kol hannose venissa al gabbe hannevela, tahor, chutz min hammassit. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannose. kol hannose venissa al gabbe hammet, tahor, chutz min hammaahil, veadam bizman shehu massit: 
Miktzat tame al hattahor umiktzat tahor al hattame, chibbure tame al hattahor vechibbure tahor al hattame, tame. rabbi shimon omer, miktzat tame al hattahor, tame. umiktzat tahor al hattame, tahor: 
Hattame al miktzat hammishkav vehattahor al miktzat hammishkav, tame. miktzat tame al hammishkav umiktzat tahor al hammishkav, tahor. nimtzet tuma nichneset lo veyotzet mimmennu bemiuto. vechen kikkar shel teruma shehu natun al gabbe mishkav vehanneyar bentayim, ben milmalan ben millemattan, tahor. vechen beeven hamenuggaat, tahor. rabbi shimon metamme vazo: 
Hannogea bezav, uvezava, uvenidda, uveyoledet, uvimtzora, bemishkav, umoshav, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad, echad hannogea veechad hammassit veechad hannose veechad hannissa:
Mishnah Zavim 5:7-10:
Hannogea bezovo shel zav, uverukko, beshichvat zaro, bememe raglav, uvedam hannidda, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad, echad hannogea veechad hammassit. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannose: 
Hannose et hammerkav vehannissa alav vehammassito, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad. hannose et hannevela, veet me chattat sheyyesh bahem kede hazzaya, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad: 
Haochel minnivlat of tahor vehi bevet habbelia, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. hichnis rosho laavir hattannur, tahor, vetahor hattannur. hekiah o velaah, metamme echad ufosel echad. ucheshehi vetoch piv, ad sheyyivlaenna, tahor: 
Hannogea besheretz uveshichvat zera, uvitme met, uvimtzora bime safro, uveme chattat sheen bahem kede hazzaya, uvinvela, uvemerkav, metamme echad ufosel echad. ze hakkelal, kol hannogea beachad mikkol avot hattumot shebbattora, metamme echad ufosel echad, chutz min haadam. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad:
Mishnah Zevachim 14:10: Ellu kadashim kerevim bammishkan. kadashim shehukdeshu lammishkan, karbenot hatztzibbur, kerevin bammishkan. vekarbenot hayyachid, bevama. karbenot hayyachid shehukdeshu lammishkan, yikrevu vammishkan. veim hikrivan bevama, patur. ma ben bamat yachid levamat tzibbur, semicha, ushechitat tzafon, umattan saviv, utenufa, vehaggasha. rabbi yehuda omer, en mincha vevama. vechihun, uvigde sharet, uchele sharet, vereach nichoach, umechitztza vaddamim, urechutz yadayim veraglayim. aval hazzeman, vehannotar, vehattame, shavim baze uvaze:
Mishnah Zevachim 14:2-5:
Harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, shehikrivan bachutz, patur, shenneemar (Vayikra 17), lifne mishkan Adonai, kol sheeno rauy lavo lifne mishkan Adonai, en chayyavin alav. baale mumin, ben baale mumin kevuim, ben baale mumin ovrim, shehikrivan bachutz, patur. rabbi shimon omer, baale mumin kevuim, patur, uvaale mumin ovrin, ovrin belo taase. torim shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan, shehikrivan bachutz, patur. rabbi shimon omer, bene yona sheavar zemannan, patur. vetorim shello higgia zemannan, belo taase. oto veet beno umechussar zeman, patur. rabbi shimon omer, hare ze velo taase. shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol shehu rauy lavo leachar zeman, hare ze velo taase veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, kol sheen bo charet, en bo velo taase: 
Mechussar zeman, ben begufo ben bivalav. eze hu mechussar zeman bivalav. hazzav, vehazzava, veyoledet, umetzora, shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz, peturin. olotehen veshalmehen bachutz, chayyavin. hammaale mibbesar chattat, mibbesar asham, mibbesar kadshe kadashim, mibbesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, hayyotzek, habbolel, happotet, hammoleach, hammenif, hammaggish, hamesadder et hashshulchan, vehammetiv et hannerot, vehakkometz, vehamekabbel damim bachutz, patur. en chayyavin alav lo mishshum zarut, velo mishshum tuma, velo mishshum mechussar begadim, velo mishshum rechutz yadayim veraglayim: 
Ad shello hukam hammishkan, hayu habbamot muttarot, vaavoda babbechorot. mishshehukam hammishkan, neesru habbamot, vaavoda bakkohanim. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol machane yisrael: 
Bau laggilgal, vehutteru habbamot. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol makom:
Mishnah Zevachim 14:6-9:
Bau leshilo, neesru habbamot. lo haya sham tikra, ella vayit shel avanim millemattan viriot milmalan, vehi hayta menucha. kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, bechol haroe: 
Bau lenov ulegivon, hutteru habbamot. kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol are yisrael: 
Bau lirushalayim, neesru habbamot, velo haya lahem od hetter, vehi hayta nachala. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, lifnim min hachoma: 
Kol hakkodashim shehikdishan bishat issur bamot, vehikrivan bishat issur bamot bachutz, hare ellu vaase velo taase, vechayyavin alehen karet. hikdishan bishat hetter bamot, vehikrivan bishat issur bamot, hare ellu vaase velo taase, veen chayyavin alehen karet. hikdishan bishat issur bamot vehikrivan bishat hetter bamot, hare ellu vaase veen bahem belo taase:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:11-12: Shelosha bene adam shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha shelosha enan rashshain lechalek. veim kevar zimmen kol echad veechad mehen bachavura shello rashshain lechalek. veenan chayyavin bezimmun shekkevar zimmenu alehen. shelosha sheyyashvu leechol pat af al pi shekkol echad veechad ochel mishshello enan rashshain lechalek:

Shete chavurot shehayu ochlin bevayit echad. bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu mitztarfin lezimmun echad. veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman. veim yesh shammash echad benehem shehu holech umeshammesh mechavura zo lachavura zo mitztarfin lezimmun echad af al pi sheen miktzat ellu roin et ellu. vehu sheyyishmeu shetehen kol divre hamevarech beveur:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:13-14: Shelosha sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk korin lo kede sheyyechavven lishmoa ma shehen omrim umezammenin alav vehu bashshuk veyotze yede chovato. velichsheyyachazor leveto yachazor vivarech birkat hammazon leatzmo aval asara sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk en mezammenin alav ad sheyyachazor limkomo veyeshev immahen:
Shelosha sheachlu keechad vekadam echad mehen uverech leatzmo mezammenin alav veyatzu hashshenayim yede chovat zimmun vehu lo yatza bezimmun ze sheen zimmun lemafrea:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:15-17: Shenayim sheachlu keechad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. veim haya echad mehen yodea veechad eno yodea ze sheyyodea mevarech bekol ram vehashsheni one amen achar kol beracha uveracha veyotze yede chovato. uven mevarech leaviv. veeved mevarech lerabbo. veishsha mevarechet levalah. veyotzin yede chovatan. aval amru chachamim tavo meera lemi sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo:

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyatzu yede chovatan bizman sheachlu velo savu shehen chayyavim levarech middivre sofrim ulefichach motziin otan katan o eved o ishsha mide chovatan. aval im achal vesava shehu chayyav bevirkat hammazon min hattora. ben ishsha ben katan o eved en motziin otan. shekkol hachayyav bedavar min hattora en motziin otan mide chovatan ella hachayyav beoto davar min hattora kemoto:

Hannichnas etzel acherim umetzaan mevarchin bevirkat hazzimmun. im matza hamevarech omer nevarech hu one baruch hu umevorach. veim matza haochlim onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello hu one acharehen amen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:8-10: En mezammenin ella al mi sheachal kezayit pat ulemala. shiva sheachlu pat ushelosha achlu immahen yarak o tzir vechayyotze bahen mitztarfin lezammen beshem. vehu sheyyihye hamevarech meochle happat. aval shishsha sheachlu pat vearbaa yarak en mitztarfin ad sheyyihyu ochle happat rov hannikkar. bamme devarim amurim baasara. aval bishlosha tzarich sheyyochlu kol echad veechad mehen kezayit pat veachar kach mezammenin:

Shenayim sheachlu vegamru milleechol uva shelishi veachal. im yecholin leechol immo kol shehu vaafillu mishshear ochalin mitztaref immahen. vechacham gadol shebbamsubbin hu shemmevarech lechullan af al pi shello ba ella baacharona:

Shelosha sheachlu keechad enan rashshain lechalek. vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha. veshishsha yesh lahem lechalek ad asara. measara ulemala enam rashshaim lechalek ad esrim. shekkol zeman sheyyechalku vetihye birkat hazzimmun lechol chelek vechelek kezimmun hakkol yesh lahem lechalek:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:1-2: Kol haochel happat shemmevarchin alav hammotzi tzarich netilat yadayim techilla vasof. veaf al pi shehi pat chullin veaf al pi sheen yadav meluchlachot veeno yodea lahen tuma lo yochal ad sheyyittol shete yadav. vechen kol davar shettibbulo bemashkin tzarich netilat yadayim techilla:

Kol hannotel yadav ben laachila ben likriat shema ben litfilla mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. shezzo mitzvat chachamim shennitztavvenu min hattora lishmoa mehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha". vmayim acharonim en mevarchin alehen sheenam ella mippene hassakkana. ulefichach chayyav adam lehizzaher bahen beyoter:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:14-16:
Haose nekev kol shehu belul shel tarnegolim kede sheyyikkanes lahen haora chayyav mishshum bone. hammachazir delet shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia chayyav mishshum bone: 
Hassoter kol shehu chayyav. vehu sheyyistor al menat livnot. aval im satar derech hashechata patur. hassoter ohel kavua o shepperek etz takua hare ze toledet soter vechayyav vehu sheyyitkavven letakken: 
Hammakke befattish hakkaa achat chayyav. vechol haose davar shehu gemar melacha hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav. ketzad. hamenappeach bichle zechuchit vehatztzar bakkeli tzura afillu miktzat hatztzura vehamegared kol shehu vehaose nekev kol shehu ben beetz ben bemattechet ben bevinyan ben bechelim hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav. vechol petach sheeno asuy lehachenis ulehotzi en chayyavin al asiyyato:
Niddah 31a:3-8: Tanu rabbanan: shelosha chodashim harishonim — valad dar bemador hattachton, emtzaiyyim — valad dar bemador haemtzai, acharonim — valad dar bemador haelyon, vechevan shehiggia zemanno latzet — mithappech veyotze, vezehu "chevle ishsha".
Vehayeynu ditnan: chevle (shel) nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar.
Veamar rabbi elazar: may kera? "asher usseti vasseter rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz". "darti" lo neemar, ella "rukkamti".
May shena chevle nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar? ze ba kederech tashmisho, veze ba kederech tashmisho, zo hofechet paneha, veze en hofech panav.

Tana: hameshammesh mittato leyom tishim — keillu shofech damim. mena yada? ella amar abbaye: meshammesh veholech, veshomer petayim Adonai".

Shevuot 45a:11-45b:3: Gemara kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin. menalan? deamar kera: "velakach bealav velo yeshallem" – mi shealav leshallem, lo shevua.

Veellu nishbain venotlin kulei. may shena sachir detakkinu le rabbanan demishteva veshakel? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halachot gedolot shanu kan. halachot? hane hilcheta ninhu?! ella ema: takkanot gedolot shanu kan.

Ella amar rav nachman amar shemuel: takkanot kevuot shanu kan – akruha rabbanan lishvua mibbaal habbayit, veshadyuha assachir; mishshum kede chayyav. mishshum kede chayyav desachir – kansinan leh levaal habbayit?! baal habbayit gufeh nicha leh demishteva sachir veshakel, ki hechi (deittagrun) [delittagrun] leh poalin.
Adderabba, sachir nicha leh dilshetva baal habbayit, venifka, ki hechi delegreh baal habbayit! baal habbayit al kurecheh agar. sachir name al kurecheh mittegar! ella baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu.
Kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit. velittev leh beedim! tericha leh milleta. velittev leh meikkara! shenehen rotzin behakkafa.
I hachi, afillu katzatz name! allema tanya: umman omer "shetayim katzatzta li", vehalla omer "lo katzatzti lecha ella achat" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya? ketzitza vadday midkar dechir leh.
I hachi, afillu avar zemanno name! allema tanya: avar zemanno velo natan lo – hare ze eno nishba venotel?
Chazaka en baal habbayit over beval talin". vehaamrat: baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu! hane mille – mikkamme delimte zeman chiyyuva hu; ki mate zeman chiyyuva – rame annafsheh umiddechar.
Sotah 48a:15-48b:1: Gemara umimmay demishshebbatla sanhedri ketiv? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, deamar kera: "zekenim mishshaar shavatu bachurim minneginatam".
Amar rav: udena deshama zimra — tiakar. amar rava: zimra beveta — chureba besippa, shenneemar: "kol yeshorer bachallon chorev bassaf ki arza era".

May "ki arza era"? amar rabbi yitzchak: bayit hamesubbach baarazim ir hu! ella: afillu bayit hamesubbach baarazim mitroea. amar rav ashe: shema minna ki matchel chureba — besippa matchel, shenneemar: "chorev bassaf". veibbaet ema mehacha: "usheiyya yukkat shaar". amar mar bar rav ashe: ledidi chaze li umenaggach ki tora.

Amar rav huna: zimra denaggade udevakkare — shere. degardae — asir. rav huna battel zimra, kam mea avoze bezuza umea sae chitte bezuza vela ibbei. ata rav chisda zalzel beh, ibbeay avoza bezuza vela ishtechach.
Amar rav yosef: zamri gavre veonya[yn] neshe — peritzuta. (zamri) [zamran] neshe veanayi[yn] gavre — keesh binoret. lemay nafka minna — levattole ha mikkamme ha.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hashshote bearbaa mine zemer, mevi chamesh pureaniyyot leolam, shenneemar: "hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu meachare vanneshef yayin yadlikem vehaya chinnor vanevel tof vechalil vayayin mishtehem veet poal Adonai lo yabbitu",

Ma ketiv acharav: "lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat" — sheggormin galut laolam, "uchevodo mete raav" — shemmeviin raav leolam, "vahamono tziche tzama" — sheggormin lattora shettishtakkach millomdeha, "vayyishshach adam vayyishpal ish" — sheggormin shiflut lesono shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veen "ish" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama", "veene gevohim tishpalna" — sheggormin shiflut shel yisrael.
Hirchiva sheol nafshah ufaara fiha livli chok veyarad hadarah vahamonah usheonah vealez bah".
Zohar, Bo 2: Ribbi elazar patach, (iyyov 1:6) vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai vayyavo gam hassatan betocham. vayhi hayyom: da (44 1) rosh hashshana, dekudesha berich hu kaim lemedan alma. kegavvna da, (Melachim b 4:11) vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma. hahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava.

Vayyavou bene haelohim, illen ravrevin memanan shelichan bealma, leashgecha beovadin divni nasha. lehityatztzev al Adonai: kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 22:19) vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo. aval lehityatztzev al Adonai behay kera ashkachna rechimuta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael. begin, dehane shelichan, deinnun memanan leashgacha al ovadin divne nasha, azlin veshatin venatlin innun ovadin kullehu, uveyoma dekae dina lemekam, lemedan alma, itavidu kategorin lemekam alayyhu divne nasha. veta chaze, mikkol ammin dealma, la kayymin leashgacha beovadehon, bar beyisrael bilchodayyhu, begin deillen benin lekudesha berich hu.

Vechad la ishtechachu ovadin deyisrael kedka yeot, kivyachol innun memanan shelichan, kad baan lekayyeyma al innun ovadin deyisrael, al Adonai vadday kayymin, deha kad yisrael avdin ovadin dela kashran, kivyachol mattishin chela dekudesha berich hu. vechad avdin ovadin dechashran, yahavin tukepa vechela lekudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 68:35) tenu oz lelohim. bema. beovadin dechashran. veal da, behahu yoma, kullehu ravrevan memanan itkanashu al Adonai. al Adonai vadday, deha kevan deal yisrael itkanashu, aleh itkanashu.

Vayyavo gam hassatan betocham, gam, leasgaa alayyhu, dechullehu atyayn lemeheve kategorin alayyhu deyisrael, veda ittosaf alayyhu, begin deihu dayltora ravreva mikkullehu, kategora mikkullehu, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, dechullehu atyayn lekatrega. miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo. vechi lo hava yada kudesha berich hu, mean hava ate. ella leayytaa ovada liruteh.

Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan vegomer vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar mishshut baaretz. mikkan olifna, deyishshuva deara itmesar lesitrin acharanin, bar ara deyisrael bilchodaha. kevan deamar mishshut baaretz, ashgach kudesha berich hu, devae lemeheve daltora alayyhu deyisrael. miyyad, (iyyov 1:8) vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz.

Chama shaata lemehav leh chulaka, bema (58 64 amud alef) deyitasak, veyitperash minnayyhu deyisrael, veha ukemuha, leraya devaa lemebar aneh bechad nahara vechulei, miyyad itassak beh hahu satan, velo kitreg alayyhu deyisrael.
Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim. lav tavavha leavda demareh avid leh kol reuteh, dihe dachil leh, ade ashgachutach mineh, vetechome i dachil lach veim lav.

Ta chaze, beshaata deaku, kad ityeyhiv chulaka chada lehay setar leitasseka beh, itperish levatar mikkolla. kegavvna da sair berosh chodesh. sair beyoma dechippure. begin deitassak beh, veshavik lehu leyisrael bemalchehon, vehacha, mata zimna lemetal chulaka da, mikkol zara deavraham, besitra achara. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 22:20) hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro vegomer.

Veta chaze, beshaata deamar mishshut baaretz, baa minneh, lemebad dina beyisrael, deha dina hava leh al avraham, lemitba mekkudesha berich hu. begin, dela itavid dina beyitzchak, kad itkeriv al gabbe madbecha, deha la hava leh leachlefa karbena deazmin al madbecha, boochara, (vechen bechol sitra dilleh) kema deat amar, (Vayikra 27) lo yachalifennu. vehacha kaim yitzchak al gabbe madbecha, vela ishtelim minneh karbena, vela itavid beh dina, uvaa da meim kudesha berich hu, kema devaa dinih deyosef lechamma darin. vechol ma devaa, beorach dina baa.

Umehahu zimna deishteziv yitzchak, veitchallaf karbaneh, zammin leh kudesha berich hu, lehahu mekatrega, hay lechulakeh, kema deat amer hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro. vehacha, mata lemetal chulakeh aleh, mikkol zareh deavraham, vela yikrav besitra achara.

Vecholla bedina ata. (sefer acher legabbeh) kema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. begin deiyyov mikkerive eta defaro hava, vechad kam paro alayyhu deyisrael, baa lekatla lon. amar leh la, ella tol mamonehon ushelot al gufehon, befulechana kashya, vela tiktol lon. amar leh kudesha berich hu, chayyecha, behahu dina mammash, tehe dain, ma ketiv, (iyyov 2:Adonai) ulam shelach na yadcha vega el atzmo veel besaro vegomer. bema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. veaf al gav divchol shear hava dachil lekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, ach et nafsho shemor. veityehiv leh reshu, lemishlat al bisra, begin raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar ba lefanay veukemuha, ba lefanay vadday, veda ihu (338 109 amud alef) ketz kol basar, velo rucha. veittemar, deihu ketz deate missitra dechoshech, kema deat amer, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. ulechol bisra, begin deit ketz achara, veikre (Daniel 12) ketz hayyamin, veda ihu ketz achara, missitra dismala, deihu choshech. veal da ityeyhiv leh reshu beatzmo uvesaro.

Vattesiteni vo levalleo. i hachi, lav bedina hava, ella bememar hahu mekatrega, deasit leh, veaste leh. ella, kolla bedina hava, vehachi amar lo elihu, (iyyov 34:11) ki foal adam yeshallem lo ucheorach ish yamtziennu. vehachi hava kema deittemar, kema deihu gazar, hachi itgezar aleh.

Vehay deamar vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam, vattesiteni levalleo la ketiv, ella vattesiteni vo, beh kayyeyma bedateh, deihu chashiv deha tesiteni, kema deamar (iyyov 10:3) veal atzat reshaim hofata. (amar iyyov itpattit al memar dehahu mekatrega) kegavvna da, (tehillim 75) vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo. vayfattuhu vaychazzevu lo. la ketiv, ella vayfattuhu befihem. befihem kayyeyma milla da deha itpatta.

Amar ribbi abba, kolla hu shappir, aval hachi olifna, ditnan, salik veastin. vechi ihu yachil leastana, in. deha ihu (resh vayyeshev tikun 141) melech zaken uchesil, dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:13) tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchesil. veal da, yachil leastana levar nash. may taama. begin deihu meheman al ovadoy divne nasha.

Ta chaze, hay bedina deyachid, aval bedina dealma, ketiv, (Bereshit 11) vayyered Adonai lirot. (Bereshit 18:21) erada na vaere. dela ityeyhiv mehemanuta ella bideh bilchodoy, deha la baa leovada alma, al memar dehahu mekatrega, detiuveteh ihu tadir leshetzaa. menalan dichtiv, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. leshetzaa kolla, hu choker. veda ihu ketz kol basar ba lefanay, vadday begin leshetzaa.

Veta chaze, vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai. kema deittemar. vehahu yoma, kayymin teren sitrin, lekabbela beni alma. kol innun deatyayn kame kudesha berich hu bityuveta uveovadin tavin, innun zachyan lemeheve ketivin legabbeh dehahu sitra deihu chayyim, veappik totzot chayyim. uman deihu missitreh, achtiv lechayyim. vechol innun deatyayn beovadin bishin, innun ketivin lehahu sitra achara deihu mota, veikre (265 1) mavt, uveh sharya mota.

Uvehahu yoma, kayymin illen teren sitrin: chayyim, umavet. it man deachtiv lesitra dechayyim. veit man deachtiv lesitra demavet. ulezimnin dealma sharya beemtzaita, i kayyeyma chad zakkaa bealma, deachra alayyhu, kullehu kayymin veachtivu lechayyim. vei chad chayyayva achra alma, kullehu achtivu lemita.

Vehahu zimna, alma hava kayyaym beemtzaita, vehahu mekatrega baa leastaa. miyyad ma ketiv, hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz vegomer. kevan deishtemoda ihu bilchodoy, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega. veal da tanenan, dela itzterich leh levar nash leitparsha mikkelala desaggiin, begin dela yitreshim ihu bilchodoy, vela yekatregun aleh leella.

Dichtiv, bashshunammit, (Melachim b 4:13) vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. la beena leappaka garmay mikkelala desaggiin, betoch ammi yativna, ad yoma da, uvetoch ammi, bichlala chada ishtemoda leella. vehacha iyyov, kevan deishtemoda leella veitreshim, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega, veamar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim, kol ma dedachil lach veittakaf, lav lemaggana avid, halo atta sachta vaado uvead vegomer. aval tol kol hay tava deant aved leh, umiyyad im lo al panycha yevarchekka. yishbok lach, veyitdabbak besitra achara, deha hasheta befatorach ihu achil, salik patorach mineh, venecheze mimman ihu, uvean sitra yitdabbak.

Miyyad, vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hinne chol asher lo beyadecha. leachazaa, didchilu deiyyov legabbeh dekudesha berich hu, hu lenatra utereh. umehacha olifna, dechol innun dedachalin leh lekudesha berich hu, al uterayyhu, o al benayyhu, lav ihu dechilu kedka yeot. veal da kitreg hahu mekatrega veamar, hachinnam yare iyyov elohim halo atta sachta vaado vegomer maase yadav berachta. veal da ihu dachil lach veityeyhiv leh reshu lekatrega beh, uleachazaa, dela palach iyyov lekudesha berich hu birchimu.
Dechevan deitnasse, nafak meorcha, vela kaim bekiumeh, ma ketiv, bechol zot la chata iyyov bisfatav. lo chata bisfatav aval biruteh chata, ulevatar chata becholla.

Vei tema dela itnasse bar nash, ha ketiv (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan vegomer. uvegin kach itnasse iyyov. veaf al gav dela kaim bekiumeh kedka yeot, la nafak mittechot reshuta demareh leitdabbeka besitra achara.

Vechamma hava hahu nissuta dileh. teresar yarche, shuletanuta dehahu sitra achara. kema detanenan, dina dechayyavaya baggehinnam 12 yarche, uvegin dela itdabbak besitra achara ketiv, (iyyov 42:12) vaAdonai berach et acharit (nidpas 181 amud bet) iyyov mereshito.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay deiyyov, lav nissuta ihu dekudesha berich hu, kenisuta dishar tzaddikayya, deha la ketiv vehaelohim nissa et iyyov, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. deavraham, ihu bideh akriv livreh yechiday dileh legabbe kudesha berich hu, veiyyov la yahiv kelum, vela masar leh lekudesha berich hu kelum.

Vela ittemar leh, deha galle kameh, dela yachil lekayyeyma beh, aval itmesar bida dimkatrega. uvedina dekudesha berich hu itavid, vekudesha berich hu ittear dina (bedina) da, lehahu mekatrega legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 1:8) hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 4:3) vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama. mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin. ihu dacha leketz yamin, veitkeriv leketz yamim. veha okimna, (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech leketz. veamar daniel, lean ketz, leketz hayyamin, o leketz hayyamim. ad deamar leh leketz hayyamin. veal da david dachil veamar, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi, o leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin. vehacha ma ketiv vayhi mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin, uvegin kach la itkabbal karbaneh, deha missitra achara hava. (kolla)

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vehevel hevi gam hu. may gam hu. leasgaa da beda, karbaneh lekudesha berich hu hava kolla, veikara dekarbena lekudesha berich hu, veyahav chulaka lesitra achara, kema deat amer umechelvehen. vekayin, ikara aved mikketz yamim, raza desitra achara, veyahiv chulaka lekudesha berich hu, veal da la itkabbal.

Beiyyov ma ketiv, (iyyov 1:4) vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vegomer, veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achyotehem leechol velishtot immahem vayhi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte vegomer, uvemishteya bechol yoma mekatrega shechiach, vela yachil leh. mena lan. dichtiv, (iyyov 1:10) halo atta sachta vaado uvead beto uvead kol asher lo missaviv uleolam la yahiv chulaka kelal legabbeh, deha (nusach acher ma) ketiv (iyyov 1:Adonai) veheela olot mispar kullam. ola salleka leella leella, vela yahiv chulaka lesitra achara. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, la yachil leh levatar, vechol ma denatal middileh natal.

Vei tema amay avish leh kudesha berich hu. ella. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, yifni archa veyistelak meal makdesha, vesitra dikdushsha istelik leella leella. veihu la aved ken, veal da kudesha berich hu tava bedina.

Ta chaze, kema deihu itperash, vela achlil tov vara, ihu dan leh behahu gavvna, yahiv leh tov, ulevatar ra, ulevatar ahadreh letov. dehachi itchaze lebar nash, leminda tov, uleminda ra, uleahdara garmeh letov, veda ihu raza dimhemanuta. ta chaze, iyyov meavde paro hava, veda hu dichtiv beh, (Shemot 9:20) hayyare et devar Adonai meavde paro. ta chaze, dela baa kudesha berich hu leaakara iyyov meatreh deihu hava michse (nusach acher kola baa kudesha behach hu leakera meatrayyhu iyyov hava mechase) (nusach acher iyyov chakkim hava) al paro kevan deitchalash avad nukemin lefaro
Zohar, Emor 38: (Vayikra 23:24) bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh, ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu kariv lon legabbeh, min kol umin ovde avoda zara, veitree behu, umeatar rechika kariv lon legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (yehoshua 24:2) vayyomer yehoshua el kol haam ko amar Adonai elohe yisrael beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam. leachazaa, deha meatar rechika itree behu, vekariv lon legabbeh, uchetiv, (yehoshua 24:3) vaekkach et avichem et avraham meever hannahar vegomer. hane kerae it leistakkela behu, vechi kol yisrael la havo yade da, vechol shekken yehoshua.

Ella orayyta kulah satim vegalya, kema dishma kaddisha satim vegalya, begin deorayyta kulah shema kaddisha hi, veal da ihi satim vegalya. i yisrael vihoshua havo yade, amay ketiv ko amar Adonai. ella vadday setima demilla, tivu saggi avad kudesha berich beyisrael, deitree behu baavahata, veavid lon reticha kaddisha illaa likareh, veappik lon miggo nahara illaa yakkira kaddisha, butzina dechol butzinin, begin deyitattar behu. hada hu dichtiv, ko amar Adonai beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam. hannahar: hahu nahar deishtemoda, veityeyda.

Meolam, may ka bae hacha. ella leachazaa chachmeta. meever hannahar meolam, ella hahu nahar olam ikre. veal da, beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam, leachazaa tivu ukeshot deavad kudesha berich hu leyisrael. vaekkach et avichem et avraham meever hannahar may ka mayyre. ella avraham la itdevak beh behahu nahar, kemo yitzchak deitdevak beh besitre leittakkefa.

Ta chaze, hay nahar, af al gav delav ihu dina, dinin nafke missitreh, veittakafu beh. vechad yitzchak ittakkaf (bedinoy) bivnoy, keden illain vetattain mitkannefe ledina, vechuresyay dedina ittakkan, umalka kaddisha yativ al kuresyay dedina, vedain alma, keden, tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. zakkain innun yisrael, deyadin lesalleka kuresyay dedina, uletakkena kuresyay derachame. uvemma. bashshofar.

Ribbi abba hava yativ kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh, ha zimnin saggiin shailna al hay shofar, may ka mayyre, vead kan la ityeyshshavna beh. amar leh, vadday hay hu berira demilla, deyisrael bayayn beyoma dedina (nusach acher da), shofar, vela keren. begin dekeren ha ityeyda bean atar ihu, uleitdabbeka dina la baena. aval ha tanenan, bemillin uveovada, baenan leachazaa uleatara millin setimin.

Ta chaze, kad hahu shofar illaa, dinhiru decholla beh, istallak vela nahir livnin, keden dina ittear, vechursevavn ittekanu leve dina, veda shofar, elo deyitzchak ikre, tukefeh deyitzchak, tushebachteh daavahan, kad istelak hahu shofar gadol, dela yanka livnin, keden yitzchak ittakkaf, veittakkan ledina bealma.

Vechad ittear hay shofar vechad bene nasha tayyvin mechataehon, bayayn lenagda kol shofar mittatta, vehahu kala salik leella, keden ittear shofara ochora illaa, veittear rachame, veistallak dina. uvaenan leachazaa ovada beshofar, leitteara shofara ochora, uleappaka behay shofar letatta, innun kale, leachazaa dechol innun kalin dilella, dichlilan kullehu behahu shofar illaa, yittearun lenafka.

Uvehane kalin diltatta, yahavin yisrael chela (lerachame mittatta veittear shofar gadol) leella, veal da baenan lezammena shofar beyoma da, ulesaddera kalin, lechavvevna beh begin leatara shofar ochora, deveh kelilan kale leella. (ulesaddera kalin bashshofar).

Sidra kadmaa, kala nafik, umitattar leella, salik rekiin, veitbaka ben ture ramae, umate legabbeh deavraham, vesharya beresheh, veitattar, veittear hu, veatkin lechuresyay. uvesifra deaggadta tanenan, beshaata dehahu kala kadmaa salik, ittear veitattar avraham, veatkin lechuresyay, pakdin aleh abba. (sefer acher abba veima) abba.

Addehachi, salleka tinyayna, takkifa (lechabbera) letavra tukefe regizin. veda sidra tinyayna, hahu kala tevira betukefoy. ucheden salleka, vechol dinin deittearun (sefer acher daataaraan) kameh ittebaru, ad desalik leatreh deyitzchak. kevan deyitzchak ittear, vechame leavraham metakken lechuresyay lekayyeyma kammeh, keden itkafya, vetavar tukepa kashya. uvehay, bae man detaka, lechavvevna libba ureuta, begin letavra chela vetukepa dedina kashya, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua, yode terua vadday.

Sidra telitaa, kala nafik, vesalik, uvaka kol innun rekiin, verachame mitaran, umate hahu kala leresheh deyaakov veyaakov ittear, vechame leavraham mittakken begisa ochora, keden achidan tarvavyyhu beh beyitzchak, da mehay sitra, veda, mehay sitra vela yachlin tukefoy lenafka levar. vehane telata sidrin, kullehu sidra chad.
Sidra ochora, kala nafik, vesalik, venatil leavraham meatreh, venagid leh letatta, laatar detukefehon deyitzchak sharyayn vekayyman leh leavraham begavavyyhu.

Sidra tinyayna, nafik kala tevira, la takkifa kekadmaa, la dechalish hahu kala detaka, ella dehahu kala lav ihu legabbe yitzchak bekadmita, detamman tukepa takkifa sharya, ella legabbe innun be dina diltatta, deinnun refuyin yattir, vechullehu chaman leavraham legabbayyhu, veitkafyayn kammeh.

Addehachi, sidra telitaa, kala nafik, vesalik, veitattar beresheh deyaakov, venagid leh letatta lehahu atar deinnun gevuran sharyayn, vekaim lokkovlayyhu, avraham mehay sitra, veyaakov mehay sitra, veinnun beemtzaita. keden itkafyayn kullehu, umishtachchin (sefer acher vameshatekakey) beatrayyhu. vehane kullehu sidra ochora tinyayna.

Sidra batraa, devayay lesalleka lon leatrayyhu, uleyayshva (sefer acher valeysheraa) benayyhu leyitzchak kemillekaddemin. begin dehay bae leyashshera leh baatreh, vela yippuk betukefoy levar, keden dinin kullehu itkafyayn, verachamin ittearu.

Al da bae lechavvevna libba ureuta behane kale, ulemehdar betiyyuveta kame marehon. keden kad yisrael metakkene umesaddere kalin biruta delibba kedka yaut, beshofara da, ahdar hahu shofar illaa, vechad ahdar, meattera leh leyaakov, veittakkan kolla. vechuresyay ochora remiu, ucheden chedu ishtechach becholla, vekudesha berich hu merachem al alma. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deyadin lenagda uleamshacha lemarehon, middina lerachame, uletakkena kullehu almin al yedayyhu.

Ta chaze, lokovel da, telata sifrin petichin beyoma da, uchema derachamin mitarin, vedinin kashyayn itkafyayn vealin leduchetayyhu. kach hu letatta kegavvna dilella, dinin kashyayn itkafyayn veitavaru mealma. uman innun. illen innun reshaim gemurim, deinnun dinin kashyayn deitkafyayn veitavaru mealma. veal da nichtavim venechottamim vechulei. amar ribbi abba, vadday da hu berira demilla, berich rachamana deshailna veravavchna behane mile.
Amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv zichron terua, zikkaron avdenan, lechavvevna libba ureuta, yisrael avdin zikkaron letatta, bema. beovada, begin deyittear milla kehahu gavvna leella.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu deitkasya beh sihara. vehech itkasya. ella, kad kayyeyma iva, veshimmesha la nahir, keden sihara itkasya, vela nahir. veal da, mikkamme iva shimsha la nahir, kol shekken sihara deitkasseya vela nehira. veal da bakkese leyom chaggenu, beHei, deitkasya sihara. uvema nahir. kolla betiyyuveta, uvekal shofara, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua keden Adonai beor panecha yehallechun.
Zohar, Vayakhel 16: Tzelota deshabbeta, deamma kaddisha, telat tzelotin ishtechachu behay yoma, lokovel telat shabbate, veukemuha, vechullehu chad. kevan dealu amma kaddisha leve kenishta, asir leishtaddela afillu betzorech be kenishta, ella bemille tushebchan utzelota, veorayyta, vechadka chaze lon.

Uman (206 amud alef, emor 105 amud alef) deishtaddal bemillin acharanin, uvemillin dealma, da ihu bar nash deka mechallel shabbeta, let leh chulaka beamma deyisrael. teren malachin memanan al da, beyoma deshabbeta, veinnun shavu yedehon al resheh, veamre, vavy liflanyya, delet leh chulaka bekudesha berich hu. veal da, bae leishtaddela bitzlota uveshirin uvetushebchan demarehon, uleishtaddela beorayyta.

Hay yoma, ihu yoma denishmatin, deitattera hahu tzerora denishmatin. (betushebchan demarehon) begin kach meshabbeche betushebchan tushbachta denishmeta, vehayeynu (138 amud alef) nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar vechulei. velet tushebachta ella besitra denishmeta verucha, vehay yoma, kayyeyma berucha venishmeta, velav degufa.

Tushebachta dedarga achara illaa, raza deyoma, shimsha kaddisha deihu nehora dimama, hayeynu yotzer or. raza dinhora denahir, deminneh itzenan venaharin kol innun chayyaylin, retichin, vechochavayya umazzale, vechol innun deshaltin al alma.
Tushebachta dealma deate beyoma da, hayeynu el adon. vetushebachta da, ihu beraza deesrin uteren atvavn illain kaddishin, demitatteran baavahan uvirticha illaa kaddisha.

Atvavn (hakedama 3 amud bet) zeirin, innun esrin uteren atvavn, deinnun bealma tattaa, deinnun el baruch gedol dea vechulei, vela it ben teva latteva, revavcha achara, ella at reshima bechol teva veteva. (132 amud bet) uvealma illaa, it revavcha, vesitrin kaddishin, ben at leat. veda ihu, tushebachta al tushebachta, deatvavn illain deyoma sheviaa, (204 amud alef) ka meshabbach veamar lemalka illaa yotzer bereshit.

Kad tushebachta da salleka leella, shitin retichin illain dekaamaran, mizdammenin venatle lehay tushebachta meamma kaddisha, vesalke lah leitattera ba, bechamma retichin illain, di memanan, vechol innun tzaddikayyay divginta deeden, kullehu mitatterin betushebachta da, vechol innun retichin, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, kullehu sallekin betushebachta da, ad raza dechuresyyay.

Kad mata lechuresyay kaddisha, tushebachta da dechol yisrael, kayyeyma tamman, ad zimna dekamre kedushsha illaa demusaf. ucheden silluka diltatta leella, leitachada kolla leella leella, lemeheve kolla chad. da ihi tushebachta, desalleka al kullehu tushebchan.

Mikkan ulehala, siddura ditzlota dishar yome, ad yismach moshe vechulei, chedvavta dedarga illaa, ikkara daavahan, dechadde behahu adva dileh, kad salik kuresyyay legabbeh, venatil lah, umitchabberan kachada. veda ihu chedva deorayyta illaa dilella, tora shebbichtav. dechadde beorayyta diltatta, tora shebbeal pe, veitchabbaru da beda.
Kevan deitchabbaru kachada, bae bar nash leachlela behahu chedva leamma kaddisha, yismechu vemalchutach shomre shabbat vechulei, elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu.
Zohar, Vayikra 44: Ribbi elazar veribbi abba havo yatve. amar ribbi elazar, chamena leabba beyome derosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, dela bae lemishma tzelota mikkol bar nash, ella i kaim aleh telata yomin kodem, ledakkea leh. deribbi shimon hava amar hachi, bitzlota dehay bar nash daana madkena, itkefar alma. vechol shekken bitkia deshofar, dela mekabbel tekiata debar nash delav ihu chakkim lemitka beraza ditkia.

Detanenan, ribbi yesa sava amar, hane tekiata kesidran. kadmaa, kelila mikkolla. tinyayna, chada kesidra vachada kesidra, gevura gedola benayyhu. telitaa, chad hacha vechad hacha gevura benayyhu. puseka salleka, 30 kumatra nachta. chad takkifa vechad rafya. veha ukemuha. veinnun asara. veinnun tesha. chad kelala decholla.

Uvehay yoma mitattera yitzchak, vehu resha laavahan. behay yoma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 33:14) pachadu vetziyyon chattaim. behay yoma yitzchak itakad, veakid kolla, vesara mallilat (sefer acher maylalet) vekol shofra takkif lachadda. zakkaa chulakeh, man deavar benayyhu, veishteziv minnayyhu. amar ribbi abba, begin kach karenan parsheta deyitzchak behay yoma, divhay yoma itakad yitzchak letatta, vitkeshar behahu dilella. (nusach acher beavraham) ematay itkeshar. beshaata dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:9) vayyaakod et yitzchak beno vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, behay yoma attar yitzchak leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. may nissa. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 49:22) veel ammim arim nissi. (Shemot 17:15) vayikra shemo Adonai nissi. may ka mashma lan. begin deishtachlil yemina veishtelim. hada hu dichtiv vehaelohim nissa et avraham. vhaelohim dayyka, vda hu (Bereshit 31:42) ufachad yitzchak.

Ribbi abba amar, ketiv (Tehillim 75:8-9) ki elohim shofet ze yashpil veze yarim. ki elohim shofet, ilmale deavar dina deyitzchak, baatar deyaakov share, (sefer acher veittase) veitchase (sefer acher veitsache) (sefer acher veitbasam) tamman, vavy lealma deyera begineh, veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 66:16) ki vaesh Adonai nishpat. veda hu itbasmuta dealma.

Vechevan deal beatra deyaakov, veyaakov achid beh, keden shachich eshsha, veitztenanu gumereh. lebar nash, dehava ragiz, vechagar vezayin garmeh, venafak berugezeh lekatla livne nasha. chad chakkima kam al pitcha, veachid beh, amar ilmale la achid bi veittekaf bi, ha katula bivne nasha ishtechach. beod deittakafu da beda, veachid da beda, itztenan rugezih al denafak lekatla. nafak leochacha, man savil rugeza vetukepa dedina dehahu bar nash. hevi ema, da dekaim appitcha.

Kacha amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, banay, la tidchalun, ha ana kaim al pitcha, aval izderazu behay yoma vehavu li chela. uvemma. beshshofar. dei ishtechach kol shofar kedka yeot, umechavvevne beh letatta, hahu kala salik, uveh mitattere avahan, vekayyme bemishkeneh deyaakov. veal da bae leizdahara beshofara, uleminda behahu kala ulechavvevna (beh).

Vlet lacha kala beshofara, dela salik rekia chad. vechol innun ochlosin dehahu rekia, yahavin atar lehahu kala, umay ka amre. (Yoel 2:11) vaAdonai natan kolo lifni chelo vegomer. vekaim hahu kala behahu rakia, ad deate kala ochora, vitattedu (sefer acher veattearu) kachada, vesallekin beziuuga lirkia ochora. veal da tanenan, it kol desalik kol, umay ihu. hahu kala ditkiata deyisrael detatta.

Vechevan demitchabberan kol innun kalin diltatta, vesallekin lehahu rekia illaa demalka kaddisha share beh, mitatteran (sefer acher mitattedan) kullehu kame malka, ucheden kuresvavn remiu vechuresyay ochora deyaakov kaim veittakkan.

Al da ashkachna besifra derav hamenuna sava, beinnun tzelote derosh hashshana, dehava amar, tzelota vekol shofara (dehahu kol) deappik hahu zakkaa, deishtechach mirucheh uminafsheh behahu shofara, dehahu kol salik leella. uvehahu yoma kayymin umishtachche mekatregin leella. vechad salik hahu kala deshofara, kullehu itdachyayn kameh, vela yachlin lekayyeyma. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyadin lechavvevna reuta lekame marehon, veyadin letakkena alma behay yoma, bekal shofara. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua. yode, vela toke.

Behay yoma, bae amma leistakkela bebar nash shelim mikkolla, deyada archoy demalka kaddisha, deyada bikara demalka, deyive alayyhu bauta behay yoma. ulezimna kal shofara bechullehu almin, bechavavna delibba, bechachmeta, biruta, bishlimu. begin deyistalak dina al yedoy min alma. vavy leinnun dishlicha dilhon la ishtechach kedka yeot, deha chove alma (amma) atyayn leadkera begineh. hada hu dichtiv, im hakkohen hammashiach yechota, dehu shelicha dechol yisrael, leashmat haam hu, begin dedina sharya alayyhu.

Vchad shelicha hu zakkaa kedka yeot, zakkain innun amma, dechol dinin mistallekin minnayyhu al yedeh, kol shekken kahana, dealeh mitbarchan illae vetattae. amar ribbi elazar, veal da, kohen velevi ad la yisllak lefulechana, badkin avatreh, veyadin archoy veovadoy, vei la, la salik lefulechana, vechen besanhedrin lemedan dina.

Vei ishtechach kadka yeot, yahavin aleh chumera demakdesha. vei la, la salik lefulechana. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:8) ulelevi amar tummecha veurecha leish chasidecha. mippeni ma zacha (aharon) leurim uletumim, ulemiflach pulechana. heve omer (Devarim 33:9) asher nissito vegomer. haomer leaviv uleimmo lo reitiv vegomer. vechevan deishtechachu beillen dargin, keden yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vegomer, yasimu ketora vegomer. leshakkecha rugeza, ulezamna shelama. vechalil al mizbechecha, begin deyitbassemun kolla, veyishtakkechun birchan bechullehu almin, keden (Devarim 33:10) barech Adonai chelo vegomer.

(Vayikra 4:13) veim kol adat yisrael yishgu venellam vegomer. rabbi shimon patach, (Yeshayahu 32:9) nashim shaanannot komna shemana koli vegomer. kamma it leh lebar nash, leistakkela bikara demareh, begin deyishtechach birya shelim kammeh kudesha berich hu, dechad bara kudesha berich hu lebar nash bara leh shelim, kema deittemar, (Kohelet 7:29) asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vegomer. et haadam dechar venukeba. venukeba itkelilat bidchura, ucheden yashar ketiv. levatar vehema vikshu cheshbonot rabbim.

rashi: Gaarta goyim. amalek, "reshit goyim" (Bamidbar 24:20):
Ibbadta rasha. avotav:
Shemam machita. "ki macho emche" (Shemot 17:14):
targum: Nezafta amme diflishtae hovadta galyat rashia shumehon mechita lealme almin:

ohc: Velo ittechem levaddechem vegomer ki et asher vegomer. kashe lamma hutzrach lomar "velo ittechem" vegomer velo hispik beamro "et asher yeshno" vegomer shehem otam shehaya medabber immahem "veet asher" vegomer, umuvan haddavar shello ittam levaddam hu koret vegomer. achen kavvanat hakketuvim hu shebba lechayyevam lekabbel alehem habberit vehaala veal zaram habbaim acharehem ad olam, vehu amro velo ittechem levaddechem perush lechayyev etchem levad ani koret ella ben otam shehem immanu ben otam vegomer, umeatta im lo haya omer ella "et asher vegomer veet asher vegomer anochi koret" lo haya nishma ella she mechayyev gam habbaim acharehem aval eno mechayyev et asher yeshno omed sham al zaram acharehem, umeamro "lo ittechem levaddechem" gilla kavvanato shebbaala atzmah shekkoret im haomdim sham mosif lechayyevam al haddorot. veshiur hakkatuv hu lo ittechem levaddechem ani mechayyev al haamur ella af al dorot habbaim acharechem, veze lo haya nishma im lo haya omer ella "et asher vegomer veet asher vegomer anochi koret berit", shehayiti omer shehem divre Adonai al habbaim acharehem lo sheyyitchayyevu haomdim sham lekabbel alehem bead habbanim.

rashi: Lo niflet hiv mimmecha. lo mechussa hi mimmecha, kemo shenneemar (Devarim 17) "ki yippale" — are yitkasse, (Eicha 1) "vattered pelaim" — vattered bematmoniyyot, mechussa, chavusha betamun:
ohc: Ki hammitzva vegomer asher anochi metzavvecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro "hayyom". od amro "lo niflet vegomer velo rechoka", halo bichlal hahaflaa hi haharchaka. od amro "velo meever layyam" vegomer, bishlama amro "lo vashshamayim hi" davar nimna mehassaga, ki mi yaale hashshamayma, aval meever layyam halo oniyyot yaavru veyikkachuha, hagam shettihye beiyye hayyam harchokim meod.

Veulay sheyyechavven hakkatuv lishne perate hammenia: echad mitztzad hassagat yediat hattora atzmah, usheniyya mitztzad kiyyum mitzvoteha. keneged meniat yediat hattora amar "lo niflet hi" vegomer, vechazar uferesh ma hi hahaflaa veamar "lo vashshamayim" vegomer, keneged heder hassagatah amar "lo vashshamayim hi" vegomer kaasher hayta battechilla, shehare moshe ala vashshamayim ulekachah lanu, vehinne hi lefanenu.

Ucheneged meniat hassagat kiyyum mitzvoteha amar "velo rechoka", vechazar uferesh ma hiv harichuk, veamar "velo meever layyam hi lemor" vegomer, perush, kemo sheera lemoshe shehagam sheala shamayim vehorid hattora, nimneu mimmennu hassagat kiyyum mitzvoteha hatteluyot baaretz, shehem kamma vechamma kimat rubbe tora, ma sheen ken hem shehissigu laavor hayyam lavo el haaretz lekayyem mitzvoteha.

Vahagam sheamar "mi yaavar lanu el ever hayyam veyikkacheha lanu", kalal yachad meniat hassagatah im meniat kiyyum mitzvoteha, uleolam ikkar haddavar shennitkavven elav bemeever layyam" hiv al meniat kiyyum mitzvoteha.

Vedikdek lomar "hayyom", perush, bizman shehayu semuchim likkanes baaretz sheaz haya karov alehem haddavar laasot, vekara layyarden yam lefi shennishpach letoch yam hammelach, kaamur bihoshua (Yehoshua 3:16): "vehayyordim al yam haarava yam hammelach tammu nichratu".

rashi: Lo vashshamayim hiv. sheillu hayta vashshamayim, hayita tzarich laalot achareha lelamdah:
Bechol tzaratam. shehevi alehem:
Lo tzar. lo hetzer lahem kefi maallehem shehayu reuyin lilkot, ki malach panav hu michael sar happanim, mimmeshammeshim lefanav hoshiam tamid bishlichuto shel makom:
targum: Bechol idan dechavu kodamohi leaytaa alehon aka la aik lehon umalach sheliach min kodamohi ferekinun berachamate uvimchase alehon ha shezvinun venatlinun vesovrinun kol yome alma:

rashi: Ki yival vegomer. "are kema demityattev ulem im betuleta, ken yityaytvin begavvechi benayychi" (targum yonatan):
targum: Are chema demityattav ulem im betuleta ken yityatvun begavaychi benaychi uchema dechade chatana im kalta yechde alach elahayich:

rashi: Ki avod tovedun. hare hammavet:
Lemaan hakim otcha hayyom lo leam. kol kach hu nichnas litroach lemaan kayyem otcha lefanav leam:

Vehu yihye lecha lelohim. lefi sheddibber lech venishba laavotecha shello lehachalif et zaram beumma acheret, lechach hu oser etchem bashshevuot hallalu shello taknituhu, achar shehu eno yachol lehibbadel mikkem. ad kan perashti peshutah shel parasha. umidrash aggada: lamma nismecha farashat attem nitztzavim lakkelalot? lefi sheshshamu yisrael mea kelalot chaser shetayim chutz mimt shebbetorat kohanim, horiku fenehem veamru mi yuchal laamod baellu? hitchil moshe lefayyesam — attem nitztzavim hayyom, harebe hichastem lammakom velo asa ittechem kelaya vahare attem kayyamim lefanav:

Hayyom. kayyom hazze shehu kayyam vehu maafil umeir, kach heir lachem vechach atid lehair lachem, vehakkelalot vehayyissurin mekayyemin etchem umatztzivin etchem lefanav; veaf happarasha shel mala mizzo piyyusin hem, attem reitem et kol asher asa; davar acher — attem nitztzavim, lefi shehayu yisrael yotzin mipparnas lefarnas — mimmoshe lihoshua — lefichach asa otam matztzeva kede lezarzam; vechen asa yehoshua (Yehoshua 24) vechen shemuel (Shmuel 1 12) "hityatztzevu veishshafta ittechem", kesheyyatzu miyyado venichnesu leyado shel shaul (80 tanchuma):
ohc: Lemaan hakim otcha vegomer. perush, taam sheani mevakkesh leharebot boonashim uvaalot hu lemaan hakim otcha lo leam, velo tichperu bo ki tifchadu meotzem haalot asher titchayyevu shettichperu beelohuto, uvaze titkayyemu leam Adonai.

Od yirtze latet taam livrit haarvut, shello yomar adam: "lamma yaase Adonai ko laavadav lehachebid ullam lechayyevam bemaase hazzulat?" laze amar ki elohim chashavah letova, lemaan hakim otcha lo leam, perush, shezzulat ze yihyu yisrael chozrim laachorehem, hayyom yifsha echad bekalla ulemachar bachamura, vehayu nishmatim meadat hakkedushsha meat meat ad sheyyifsha yisrael mihyot am Adonai, uvema sheasaam arevim yittenu lev leover avera achat kalla kevachamura veyitkayyemu leam segulla. ha lamadta shekkol maase Adonai eno ella letovatenu lahakimenu.

rashi: Vattiru et shikkutzehem. al shem shehem meusim kashshekatzim:
Gillulehem. shemmusrachim umeusin kaggalal:

Etz vaeven. otan shel etzim veshel avanim reitem baggaluy, lefi sheen haggoy yare shemma yigganvu, aval shel kesef vezahav immahem, bechadre maskitam hem, lefi shehem yereim shemma yigganvu (tanchuma):
Yochluhu. musav al deganech (yeshaya 62:8):
Yishtuhu. musav al tiroshech (Yeshayahu 62:8):
targum: Are dechanshohi leibbura yechlune vishabbechun kodam Adonai udeatzrohi lechamra yistune bedarat kudeshi:

rashi: Yikkovennu. yefarshennu:
targum: Veyechzun ammaya zechutich vechol malchaya yekarich veyikron lich shema chadta di vememre dayya yifreshinah:

rashi: Umeammim en ish itti. mityatztzev lefanay lehillachem:
Veyez nitzcham. damam, shehu takpo venitzchono shel adam:
Egalti. kemo "nigalu vedam" (Eicha 4:14):
targum: Ha keviut demitbaet bematzera ken yisge ketol bemashiryat ammaya vela yehe lehon tekof kodamay veektelinun berugezi vaadushinun bechamti veetbar takifehon kodamay vechan chakkimehon esalim:

rashi: VaAdonai leolam yeshev vegomer. shem shalem vechisse shalem, kemo shenneemar: kiso; aval kodem sheyyimmache ketiv "ki yad al kes yah" (Shemot 17:16) – kes chaser veshem chaluk:
targum: Umemra dayya lealmin motveh bishme meroma takin ledina kureseh:

rashi: Havu laAdonai mishpechot ammim. uma tittenu lo? havu laAdonai kavod vaoz:
targum: Havu zemar kodam Adonai yechuse amaya havu kodam Adonai aykar veushena:

rashi: Kechatan. asher yilbash levushe peer kechohen gadol:
Vechakkalla tade cheleha. tachshiteha:
targum: Amarat yerushelem mechda echde bememra dayya tevua nafshi befurekana deelahi are albeshani levushin defurekan mein dizchu itfani kachatana demitzlach bignune uchechahana rabba dematkan bilvushohi uchechalta demitkashta vetikunaha:

rashi: Vehitbarech bilvavo. leshon beracha, yachashov belibbo birkat shalom leatzmo lemor, lo yevouni kelalot hallalu, ach shalom yihye li:
Vehitbarech. banedayraa shavya belaaz, kemo vehitgallach, vehitpallel:
Bishrirut libbi elech. bemarit libbi, kemo (Bamidbar 24) "ashurennu velo karov", kelomar, ma shellibbi roe laasot:

Lemaan sefot harava. lefi sheosif lo puranut al ma sheasa ad henna veshogeg, vehayiti maavir alehem, vegorem atta sheatzarfem im hammezid veeppara mimmennu hakkol, vechen tirgem unkelos "bedil leosafa le chete shaluta al zedanuta" — sheosif lo ani hashshegagot al hazzedonot:
Harava. shogeg, shehu ose cheadam shikkor shehu ose shello middaat:
Hatztzemea. shehu ose middaat uvetaava:
Vaabbit veen ozer leyisrael:
Veeshtomem. leshon 'shetika, uchevar perashti lemala "vayyishtomem ki en mafgia" (Yeshayahu 59:16):

Vachamati hi semachatni. chamati sheyyesh li al haummot, asher "ani katzafti meat" al ammi "vehemma azru leraa" (Zecharya 1:15), hi semachatni – chizzeka yadi veorra et libbi lippara mehem, veaf al pi sheen yisrael reuyin vahagunim ligulla:
targum: Ugele kodamay velet gevar deleh ovadin tavin vidiya kodamay velet enash dikum veyive alehon uferaktinun bidra tukefi uvememar reuti seadtinun:

rashi: Veavus. leshon mitgolel bedam vedorech baraglayim, kemo "mitboseset bedamayich" (Yechezkel 16:6), uchemo "bossu et chelkati" (Yirmeyahu 12:10):
Nitzcham. gevurat nitzchonam:
targum: Vaakatel ammaya berugezi vaadoshshinon bechemti veerme laara arita ketile gibbarehon:

rashi: Veet asher enennu po. veaf im dorot haatidim lihyot:
Ivru ivru bashshearim. "amar neviyyay: ivru vetuvu betarayya, afnu libba deamma leorach takna" (targum yonatan):
Sollu sollu hamesilla. kivshu hadderech 111 236 109. sollu leshon 'mesilla hu:
Sakkelu meeven. sakkelu hammesilla vehashelichu avne michshol latztzedadin, sakkelu. 871 109:
Meeven. mihyot sham even, ucheneged yetzer hara hu omer (tanchuma behaalotcha 10), veyesh od lefotro al tikkun hadderachim lekibbutz haggaliyyot:
Harimu nes. kelonas, 387 109. ot hu sheyyikkavtzu elay, veyaviu li et haggolim etzlam:
targum: Amar neviya avaru vetuvu betaraya afno lev ama leorach takna basru besuran tavan venechaman letzadikaya disliku hirhur yitzra dehu keeven takla arimu ata al ammaya:

ohc: Vehaya chi yavou alecha kol haddevarim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "kol haddevarim haelle", velo hispik beamro "ki yavou alecha habberacha vehakkelala asher natatti lefanecha"?

Veulay sheyyechavven al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet berachot (berachot ned.) chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova, veheemiduhu baggemara (berachot 60.) lekabbel haraa besimcha kederech shessameach al hattova.

Vehu amro "vehaya", shehu leshon simcha (Bereshit Rabba 42,3), "chi yavou alecha kol haddevarim" – tekabbelem besimcha, behashevaa yachad habberacha vehakkelala. veim haya omer "chi yavou alecha habberacha vehakkelala asher natatti lefanecha", haya nishma hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "vehaya" shehu hassimcha "chi yavou alecha habberacha", vetevat "vehakkelala" nimshechet im maamar "asher natatti lefanecha" shelleachareha, velo hayiti yodea shechozer maamar "vehaya" gam al hakkelala.

Od hitztzatzti vaere ma naama chibbat hakkodesh asher chibbev elohenu otanu, halo tire ki bezichron habberacha higgia otah alenu, veamar "ki yavou alecha habberacha", uvezichron hakkelala amar "vehakkelala asher natatti lefanecha" velo "alecha", uletaam ze amar "asher natatti lefanecha", velo hispik bemaamar "kol haddevarim haelle".
