Gam im haya omer "ki yavou alecha habberacha vehakkelala asher natatti lefanecha", hayiti mefaresh maamar "asher natatti lefanecha" al shenehem, aval meamro "kol haddevarim haelle" gilla baze yittur "asher natatti lefanecha", shebba lehavedil ben habberacha lakkelala kemo shepperashti. ulederech ze amro "kol haddevarim haelle" chozer el habberacha haamura besamuch lah. veal yera beenecha amro "haddevarim" leshon rabbim, vehabberacha leshon yachid, ki harebe devarim tovim nichlelu babberacha.

Habberacha vehakkelala. perush, lo mibbaya beod hattova alehem, im hirshiu vechazru bitshuva sheyyihyu merutztzim el Adonai, ella afilu achar shennimasu beene Adonai veshalach bam charon appo vehiddicham meal panav, uletzad hatztzara asher tesovvem chozrim bitshuva, keamro "vahashevota vegomer bechol haggoyim", af al pi chen yashiv Adonai shevutam.

Veyesh lehair lamma hutzrach lomar habberacha, kevan sheddavar hassovev hatteshuva hu mora hakkelala, lo haya lo lomar ella "ki yavo alecha hakkelala". venire ki va lehair davar shebbo yashiv el libbo lashuv bitshuva, vehu ki yaskil behetivo maasav lifne Adonai baruch hu habberacha asher tesovvennu, veet asher yasur minni orach hachayyim hakkelala asher tevoehu, umizze yaskil lehashiv el libbo, ki zulat mivchan habberacha sheyyihye bah baasot retzono yitbarach, lo yatzdik sibbat hakkelala shehi letzad azvo et Adonai.

Vahashevota el levavecha. perush, letzad sheharshaim levavam toe, laze amar "vahashevota el levavecha" shenehem hattoim bederech lo tov. veamro "bechol haggoyim" vegomer perush, bechoach taanat heyoto gole veniddach bechol haggoyim, veyomar lelibbo: "ree ma garmu maasay haraim", veyeda ki ra vamar azvo et Adonai. vehu amro "vahashevota el levavecha" betaanat "kol haggoyim asher hiddichacha Adonai shamma", ucheillu amar kaasher hiddichacha Adonai bechol haggoyim.

Vetaam sheddibber hakkatuv bederech ze, leheyot sheyyimtza hammesit taana listor hochachat haggaluyyot, beamro ki halo kamma vechamma mehaummot sheyyikre lahem kaze sheyyiglu meal admatam, laze amar "bechol haggoyim", ki en galut kegalut yisrael asher nitpazzeru bearba ruchot haolam, vehu amro "bechol haggoyim asher hiddichacha Adonai shamma".

Veamar haddor vegomer verau vegomer. kashe lamma hikdim haamira lariyya, shealeha hem omrim, shehaya lo lomar "verau haddor haacharon vegomer vehannachri vegomer veamru" vegomer, uma gam shello haya tzarich lomar "veamar" vegomer shehare hu omer achar kach "veamru" vegomer. od lamma hitchil ledabber leshon yachid vegamar omer "veamru" leshon rabbim, "veamru kol haggoyim"?

Venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech, "veamar haddor haacharon" shehem benechem, vehutzrach lefaret lefi sheyyesh dorot mehaummot, velo hu bilvad amar ella gam "hannachri asher yavo" vegomer, perush nachri hassamuch vegam habba meeretz rechoka, ucheillu amar "vaasher yavo" vegomer "verau" perush hannachrim hahem karov verachok "et makkot haaretz" vegomer. "veamru kol haggoyim", gam hem nosaf al maamar haddor haacharon "benechem" vegomer "al me asa" vegomer. vehizkir "verau" bannachrim velo baddor haacharon benehem, lefi sheellu metzuyim hem bimchoz yisrael veroim hannaase, velo hutzrach lomar bo "verau". veamro "kol haggoyim", yodia hakkatuv ki haroim yaggidu lakkol et asher hifli Adonai asot bair hahi:

Vechol maamar ze hu keneged chalukka rishona shehizkir hakkatuv "pen yesh bachem ish vegomer o mishpacha o shevet vegomer lalechet laavod" vegomer, lefi shehakkelalot sheyyiched ad atta hayu keneged chalukka sheniyya "baal shoresh pore rosh velaana" uchevar macha et shemo mittachat hashshamayim, umikkan hu matchil onesh harishon "verau et makkot" vegomer.

Veamro al asher azvu vegomer, vayyelchu vayyaavdu vegomer. karashum bitchillat hammaamar "lalechet laavod", velaze lo amar "umacha Adonai et shemam", ella shimmon artzam ulehaglotam meal admatam veyashlichem el eretz acheret vegomer:

rashi: Haidoti vachem hayyom et hashshamayim veet haaretz. shehem kayyamim leolam, vechaasher tikre etchem haraa yihyu edim sheani hitreti vachem bechol zot; davar acher — haidoti vachem hayyom et hashshamayim vegomer, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael, histakkelu vashshamayim shebbarati leshammesh etchem, shemma shinnu et middatam? shemma lo ala galgal chamma min hammizrach veheir lechol haolam kainyan shenneemar (Kohelet 1) "vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh"? histakkelu vaaretz shebbarati leshammesh etchem, shemma shinneta middatah? shemma zeratem otah velo tzamcha o shemma zeratem chittim veheelta seorim? uma ellu shennaasu lo lesachar velo lehefsed, im zochin en mekabbelin sachar veim chotin en mekabbelin puranut, lo shinnu et middatam, attem sheim zechitem tekabbelu sachar veim chatatem tekabbelu puranut, al achat kamma vechamma (sifre Devarim 32):

Uvacharta bachayyim. ani more lachem shettivcharu bechelek hachayyim, keadam haomer livno, bechar lecha chelek yafe venachalati, umaamido al chelek hayyafe veomer lo et ze beror lecha, veal ze neemar (Tehillim 16) "Adonai menat chelki vechosi atta tomich gorali" — hinnachta yadi al goral hattov lomar et ze kach lecha:
ohc: Haidoti vachem vegomer. pasuk ze meyuttar, shehare amar besamuch "ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et hachayyim veet hattov" vegomer (Devarim 30:15). od tzarich ladaat lamma shinna misseder sheamar lemala, sheose chalukkat hattov bifne atzmo, keamro (Devarim 30:15) "et hachayyim veet hattov, et hammavet veet hara", vechan amar "hachayyim vehammavet vegomer habberacha vehakkelala". od tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar ella "uvacharta bachayyim", velo amar "veet hattov".

Venire behair, lamma hifsik bemaamar "natatti lefanecha" ben maamar "hachayyim vehammavet" lemaamar "habberacha vehakkelala", shehaya lo lehakedim velomar "natatti lefanecha hachayyim" vegomer, o achar sheyyomar "vehakkelala" yomar "natatti lefanecha"?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi lehair, ki shene yiudim – echad tov veechad ra – hem baolam hazze. velaze amar befasuk ze "hachayyim vehammavet natatti lefanecha", perush, sachar veonesh hannetunim lefanecha, perush, baolam hazze, hem hachayyim vehammavet. im yetivu – yichyu, veim yarshiu – yamutu. ellu hashshenayim hem lefanecha baolam hazze.

Veyesh shenayim acherim, vehem habberacha vehakkelala, hem yiudim laolam habba, veenam lefanav ella leachar mita, al derech amro (Devarim 28:6) "baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha", ulehefech arur hu vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava metzia 107.) shemmedabber al yetziato min haolam, velaze hifsik bemaamar "natatti lefanecha" ben shene yiudim harishonim lashshenayim haacharonim.

Velaze gamar omer "uvacharta bachayyim", shehu yiud olam hazze, ki yitkarev lev haadam beyoter lema shellefanav, kederech amro (Devarim 11:13) "vehaya im shamoa tishmeu vegomer venatatti metar artzechem", hare shello hizkir lehattot levav enosh ella baddevarim hanniglim baolam hazze:

Kemo chen amar kan "uvacharta bachayyim", perush, yitchayyev haddavar afillu kefi teva haggashmi livchor bachayyim. vahagam shebbefasuk shellifne ze (Devarim 30:15) amar "ree natatti lefanecha hachayyim vehattov" yachad, sham nitkavven bemaamar "lefanecha" livchor bahem, vechan nitkavven bemaamar "lefanecha" lomar ma shellefanecha, veheir al zot hakkavvana bema shessidderah beemtza hayyiudim kemo shepperashti, gam bema sheggamar omer "uvacharta bachayyim" kemo shepperashti.

rashi: Mechotev etzecha. melammed shebbau chenaaniyyim lehitgayyer bime moshe kederech shebbau givonim bime yehoshua, vezehu haamur baggivonim (Yehoshua 9) "vayyaasu gam hemma bearma", unetanam moshe chotve etzim veshoave mayim (80 tanchuma):

ohc: Veshavta ad Adonai elohecha. amro "veshavta", velo hispik bema sheamar "vahashevota el levavecha", lefi ma shepperashti ki "vahashevota el levavecha" vegomer hu taanat hannitztzachon lelibbo hattoe, veze leinyan lehakkir ki lo tov asa, vehatteshuva lifne Adonai lehetiv derachav hu maamar "veshavta ad".

rashi: Lemaan tziyyon. eese vlo echeshe al ma sheasu lah:
Lo eshkot. lo yehe shalom lefanay, ad yetze channoga tzidkah:
targum: Ad deabed purekan letzion la aniach leammaya vead deayte nechama lirushelem la ashket lemalkevata ad deyitgele kishfarfara nehora ufurekana kevair yivar:

rashi: Hinne secharo. shemmuchan latet laavadav muchan itto:
Ufeullato. sechar happeulla sheppaalu immo lefanav, hu muchan latet:
targum: Ha Adonai ashma lisyafe ara emaru lichnishta detzion da farkich mitgele ha agar avde memre ime vechol ovadehon gelan kodamohi:

rashi: Al yedutun. al haddatot veal haddinin haovrim al yisrael:
targum: Leshabbacha al yad yedutun leasaf tushebcha:

rashi: Molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto. hakkadosh baruch hu haya molich limin moshe et zeroa gevurato; bechol et shehaya tzarich leezrato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, haya zeroo muchan limino:
targum: Dabber leyamina demoshe dera tushebachte beza me yama desuf min kodamehon lemebad leh shum alam:

rashi: Hannistarot laAdonai elohenu. veim tomru ma beyadenu laasot? atta maanish et harabbim al hirhure hayyachid, shenneemar "pen yesh bachem ish vegomer", veachar kach "verau et makkot haaretz hahiv", vahalo en adam yodea temunotav shel chavero en ani maanish etchem al hannistarot, shehen laAdonai elohenu, vehu yippara meoto yachid, aval "hanniglot lanu ulevanenu" levaer hara mikkirbenu, veim lo naase din bahem yeanshu harabbim. nakud al lanu ulevanenu lidrosh sheaf al hanniglot lo anash et harabbim ad sheavru et hayyarden, mishshekkibbelu alehem et hashshevua behar gerizim uvehar eval venaasu arevim ze laze (sota 37; 80 sanhedrin 43):
ohc: Hannistarot vegomer vehanniglot. perush, hi teshuvat yisrael lemoshe, shehannistarot lo yitchayyevu bahem, aval hanniglot kiyyemu vekibbelu alehem haarvut. veamro "ulevanenu ad olam", kan kibbelu alehem veal zaram acharehem kemo shehitna moshe bappasuk (Devarim 29:13) "velo ittechem" vegomer kemo shepperashnu.

rashi: Attem nitztzavim. melammed shekkinnesam moshe lifne hakkabba beyom moto lehachenisam babberit:
Rashechem shivtechem. rashechem leshivtechem:
Ziknechem veshotrechem. hechashuv chashuv kodem, veachar kach kol ish yisrael:
ohc: Attem nitztzavim. tzarich ladaat kavvanat maamar ze. od lamma hutzrach lefaret rashechem vegomer tappechem vegomer velo hispik lomar bederech kelal "kullechem". od tzarich ladaat taam habberit hazze, halo besamuch amar "elle divre habberit" (Devarim 28:69), veim ratza lichlol gam haamur befarasha zo bichlal habberit, haya lo lehakedim haddevarim veyomar al hakkol "elle divre habberit".

Venire ki kavvanat moshe bivrit ze hu lehachenisam bearvut ze al ze, kede sheyyishtaddel kol echad bead chavero leval yaavor pi Adonai, veyihyu nitpasim ze bead ze. vehaed hanneeman ma sheggamar omer "hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu" vegomer (Devarim 29:28), hare sheal haarvut medabber hakkatuv. veen ze habberit sheamar besof parashat tavo, ki oto berit hu al atzman, veze sheyyitchayyev kol echad al achihu haivri kefi hayyecholet shebbeyad kol echad.

Umeatta banu lehavin maamar attem nitztzavim, shehakkavvana hu al derech amro (Rut 2:5) "hannitztzav al hakkotzrim" – leshon minnuy. veamro kullechem perush, kullam yesh alehem ol ze, kol echad lefi ma shehu, al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet shabbat (shabbat ned:): kol mi sheyyesh beyado limchot bechol haolam nitpas al kol vechulei, vechol mi sheyyesh beyado limchot beanshe iro nitpas al anshe iro, vechol mi sheyyesh beyado limchot bivne veto nitpas al vechulei. vehu ma shepperat hakkatuv kan veamar rashechem vegomer, shekkol echad yitchayyev kefi ma sheyyesh beyado. rashechem – hem haggedolim shebbechullan sheyyecholin limchot bechol yisrael, ellu yitchayyevu al hakkol. shivtechem – kol shevet veshevet yitchayyev al shivto. ziknechem veshotrechem – kol zaken yitchayyev al mishpachto. kol ish yisrael – hem hehamon, kol echad yitchayyev al bene veto. laze hifsik hakkatuv kan vesidder tappechem vegomer bifne atzmam, ki ellu acherim nitpasim alehem shehem harshumim bappasuk shellefanav, kol echad kefi ma shehu, veen hem nitpasim al acherim, shehattaf enam bene daat, vehannashim kemo chen, haggerim gam ken en lahem lehistarer al yisrael, uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (yevamot ma:) bappasuk (Devarim 17:15) "som tasim alecha" vegomer, kol mesimot sheatta sam alecha lo yihye ella mikkerev achecha velo gerim, aval yisrael chayyavin alehem, keamram zichronam livracha (nidda 13:): kashim gerim leyisrael kassappachat, ufershuhu lefi sheenam melammedim otam kechol hatztzorech, ha lamadta shennitpasim alehem.

Od ramaz beamro attem nitztzavim vegomer lifne Adonai, lefi shekkol shehu meruchak mehakkedushsha komato nemucha verosho shefala (Bereshit Rabba 12,6), laze amar ki lihyot lifne Adonai nitztzevu venasu rosham.

rashi: Ki attem yedatem vegomer. lefi sheritem haummot, veshemma hissi lev echad mikkem oto lalechet acharehem, pen yesh bachem vegomer, lefichach ani tzarich lehashebiachem:
ohc: Ki attem yedatem vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze davar noten hakkatuv taam "ki attem yedatem", veramban zichrono livracha peresh shehu taam lehaamur acharav besamuch "pen yesh bachem" vegomer, vehu ketzat dochak lehakedim taam lema sheatid lomar achare chen. veulay sheddibber hakkatuv beseder ze lehair davar echad, vehu ki lefi shehitzricham hakkatuv lehikkanes lechayyev immahem gam habbaim acharehem, yomar haomer sheshshurat haddin menaggedet haddavar, shehare en chavin leadam shello befanav (ketuvot 11.), velo toil kabbala zo sheyyekabbelu haavot al habbanim. laze amar ki attem yedatem vegomer vattiru vegomer, perush reitem sheenam ella sheketz vetoeva, umeatta enchem ella zochim lahem lerachakam mittoavot haggoyim velivchor belohim chayyim, vicholin attem lechayyevam kemotchem. vehu ma sheddikdek likrotam shikkutzehem vegillulehem, lomar sheyyadu vehiskilu hashepalatam umeisutam.

rashi: Veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha. haya lo lichtov "veheshiv" et shevutecha, rabbotenu lamdu mikkan kivyachol shehashshechina sheruya im yisrael betzarat galutam, ucheshennigalin hichtiv geulla leatzmo — shehu yashuv immahem. veod yesh lomar sheggadol yom kibbutz galuyyot uvekoshi, keillu hu atzmo tzarich lihyot ochez beyadav mammash ish ish mimmekomo, kainyan shenneemar (Yeshayahu 27) "veattem telukketu leachad echad bene yisrael", veaf begaluyyot shear haummot matzinu chen (Yirmeyahu 48) "veshavti shevut moav":
ohc: Veshav Adonai vegomer. perush, chelke hakkedushsha shennishbu mitztzad maasecha haraim shekkadmu, yeshivem Adonai mehashshabbay, ze keneged geullat shivyat hannelam, ucheneged shivyat hannigle amar "veshav" vegomer:

rashi: Ki karov elecha. hattora nittena lachem bichtav uveal pe:
Mishpati vedini. tevot kefulot bammikra veen chilluk benehem, kemo "edi vesahadi bammeromim" (Iyov 16:19), "atzamav afike nechusha geramav kimtil barzel" (Iyov 40:18):
Mishpati vedini. bashshamayim:
Yashavta lechisse. kisse hammishpat:
targum: Metul daavadta pureanuti vedini yetevta al kurese dayana zakkaa:

rashi: Chasde Adonai azkir. hannavi amar: azkir et yisrael et chasde Adonai:
Verav tuv. azkir asher gamal levet yisrael brachamav:
targum: Amar neviya tivuta dayya ana madkar tushebachta dayya keal kol degamlana Adonai vesagi tuve levet yisrael degamlinun kerachamohi uchesagyut tuve:

rashi: Yadi. makkati:
Layla niggera. baggalut ze shehu kelayla, hi niggera lecha umara:
Velo tafug. velo tidme niggeratah:
targum: Beyom akti ulefan min kodam Adonai tevaet sherat alay nevua belelya zilgat eni dimata vela sefug serivat leitnechama nafshi:

rashi: Leovrecha. lihyotcha over babberit, velo yittachen lefarsho kemo lehaavircha, ella kemo laasotchem otam:

Leovrecha bivrit. derech haavara kach: hayu chorte veritot osin mechitztza mikkan umechitztza mikkan veovrim bentayim, kemo shenneemar "haegel asher kartu lishnayim vayyaavru ben betarav" (Yirmeyahu 34):
ohc: Leavrecha bivrit vegomer uvealato. taam amro uvealato velo hispik "bivrit", yitbaer behair od lamma meikara hutzrach livrit velo hispik gezerat melech bemora hoonashim hakketuvim battora. achen taam haddavar hu lefi shettavo hassevara laadam lomar sheyyaavor avera achat vehu sheyyimrod baikkar veyeanesh onesh echad al avera achat, veyoter nachon hu lo meheyot mode baAdonai uvetorato veyitchayyev al 36 keretot vechamma mitot veonashim, asher al ken nitchakkem Adonai veheeviram bivrit lechayyevam al kol perat uferat, uveer hashshevua shehu al ze hadderech shennishbain lekayyem kol davar, veim yaavru vivattelu echad mehem tavo alav haala hakketuva, vehu amro bivrit vegomer uvealato, umeatta hagam sheyyachshevu lichpor baikkar lo yaspik lahem onesh echad al avon ze veyitchayyevu al kol avon veavon kechol alot habberit.

rashi: Ketzel kintoto. leet erev:
Ninarti. leshon tishnok veteruf veotem kaarbe shehu noded vena umetoraf (yerushalmi berachot 4.) (matzati):
targum: Hech tula betzalayuteh itgamret italtelet hech govai:

rashi: Haoyev tammu. ki choravot hassina lanetzach hem alav kecherev chadda. davar acher: choravot lanetzach – oto oyev shechoravot sinato hayta alenu lanetzach, vezehu amalek shenneemar bo "veevrato shamra netzach" (Amos 1:11). lashon acher: choravot – leshon churban, vechen pitrono: haoyev tammu choravot lanetzach, vechen neemar "shimmot olam ettencha vearecha lo tashuvna" (Yechezkel 35:9):
Vearim natashta. "ki tomar edom rushshashnu venashuv venivne choravot ko amar Adonai tzevaot hemma yivnu vaani eheros" (Malachi 1:4):
Avad zichram. otah hashshaa:
targum: Vechad nefal beel devava ishtetzayu chelvateh ucherakkehon itztadyu lealma vekirvehon tzedita hovadta dachranhon minhon:

rashi: Veim yifne levavcha. hare hara:

Yeshan af Adonai. al yede chaas hagguf mitchammem veheashan yotze min haaf, vechen (Shmuel 2 22:9) "ala ashan beappo", veaf al pi sheen zo lifne hammakom, hakkatuv mashmia et haozen kederech shehi regila vichola lishmoa kefi derech haaretz:
Vekinato. leshon chema, aneparetameynet, achizat levishat nekama veeno maavir al hammidda:
Ezkera elohim. hachesed shehaya ragil laasot li bime chibbati:
Asicha. beotan chasadim vetovot:
Vetitattef ruchi. pashmir belaaz:
targum: Edkar elaha veergush kodam Adonai amalel vetishtalhe ruchi lealmin:

rashi: Achazta shemurot enay. shemurot leshon ashmurot hallayla, sheadam neor mishshenato vedato meyushshevet velibbo chozer alav. vaani eni ken ballayla zo shel galut: tamid enay nidbakot, keadam nirdam meotem lev. batztzarot sheani roe nifama ruchi veen haddibbur bi:
targum: Achadta timorata deaynay itarfet vela amalel:

rashi: Pen yesh bachem. shemma yesh bachem:
Asher levavo fone hayyom. millekabbel alav habberit:
Shoresh pore rosh velaana. shoresh megaddel esev mar kaggidin shehem marim, kelomar — mafre umarbe resha bekirbechem:
ohc: Pen yesh bachem vegomer lalechet laavod vegomer. kan hizhir hakkatuv al machshevet avoda zara, shemmazhir keamro "pen" al asher levavo fone lalechet laavod vegomer:

Pen yesh bachem vegomer shoresh vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu hashshoresh pore rosh vegomer, im chozer laasher levavo fone vegomer haamur besamuch lo haya lo lomar "pen yesh bachem" paam sheniyya, ella haya lo lomar al ze hadderech: "pen yesh bachem ish vegomer shoresh pore rosh velaana asher levavo" vegomer. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat haddevarim atzman shel shoresh pore vegomer, shennire sheeno pore rosh velaana, ella shoresh. od tzarich ladaat beracha zo shemmitbarech ze hashshoresh pore rosh bilvavo bamme mitbarech. od amro "lemor". od netinat taam ze sheomer "ki bishrirut" vegomer, uma hu amro "lemaan" vegomer?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu leval yachshov adam bedato lehakel mealav ol haonesh, veyisbor bedato sheeno ose avel baze, ella mishtaddel besichlo leval yitchayyev bechol hakkelalot, uleolam eno choshev bedato laavor pi Adonai gedola uketanna, ucheneged ze amar hakkatuv pen yesh bachem shoresh pore rosh velaana, perush sheatta eno ella shoresh, umodia shemmimmennu yifre rosh velaana kaasher avaer.

Uferash hakkatuv ma hu hashshoresh veamar "vehaya beshamo et divre haala", amar vehaya leshon simcha ki yismach beshamo shehaddavar chiyyuvo hu mitztzad haala shezze yaggid shezzulat haala lo yitchayyev, vehitbarech bilvavo yivtach shello tavo alav hakkelala besibbat levavo al ze hadderech, lemor perush yomar shalom yihye li ki bishrirut vegomer, perush hagam sheyyashbiem moshe veyaane amen hu yevattelennu belibbo, vehaikkar bishvua hu hallev, uchedivre rabbi akiva sheamar (shavuot 26.) "haadam bishvua" shetztzarich sheyyihye libbo ufiv shavim, vechol shemmevattel belibbo hagam shemmotzi bisfatav en anu holchim ella achar machshevet hallev, vehu amro ki bishrirut libbi elech ki haikkar shettaluy bo inyan hashshevua hu hallev velaze kinna lo hashsherira, uvema shello yekabbel hashshevua belibbo lo yitchayyev kol haonesh haamur ben al atzmo lo yitchayyev ella onesh avera achat kemo shekkatavnu, ben habbanim banav lo yechayyevem bechoach shevuato, ben beinyan haarvut al hazzulat, vehu amro lemaan sefot harava et hatztzemea perush "sefot" leshon kerita, uferush "rava" hu kinnuy leribbuy, utzemea" hu kinnuy lemuat, vehakkavvana shemmitchakkem lichrot ribbuy haonesh laasoto muat bema shemmevattel belibbo hashshevua.

Vedavar ze kerao moshe "shoresh", shemmimmennu yifre rosh velaana. hattaam ki kelum ikkar taam hashshevua hu, kede shebbaze yitchazzek neged hammachti, kederech amro (tehillim 119:106) "nishbati vaakayyema", uchemaase boaz shennishba leyitzro (Bamidbar Rabba 15:16). velaze adam shechoshev machshava zo hu pittuy bechinat hara, shemmashrish bo shoresh ra, kede sheachar ken yihye nakel lehasherish bemeav shoresh resha lehateiv maasav, veyomar elav: kelum haddavar taluy ella bishvua, atta lo nishbata, kum ase lecha elohim vaase asher titavve asot.

Vekara lammaase hara "rosh velaana", letzad shehaaverot tamam rosh velaana, vehu sod tippa mara shebbecherev malach hammavet (avoda zara 20:), shettithavve meaverot haadam, besod "teyasserech raatech" (yirmeya 2:19), ulehefech bemaase hattov besod "taamu ureu ki tov Adonai" (tehillim 34:9).

Veyiched hakkatuv onesh laze yater al hammekabbelim habberit, veamar "lo yove" vegomer, perush, hagam she middato hi limchol velisloach laavonot ammo yisrael keshemchallin panav kayyadua, ze haish "lo yove Adonai". amar lashon ze "lo yove", nitkavven lomar she yahafoch bo retzono shessoleach velo yove lisloach. vehayyotze middavar ze keshello yove Adonai seloach lo, hu "ki az yeshan af Adonai". amro "az", perush, kesheyyecheta achar kach sheppara rosh velaana, az bimkom shechashav lehakel ansho, venahafoch hu sheyyeshan af Adonai vekinato baish hahu veravtza bo kol haala hakketuva bassefer hazze.

Venimtza ki millevad shello hirviach kelum bemachshavto haraa, shehare kol haraa tevoennu, od lo shettirbotz bo kol haala, ma shello yihye lo chen im yekabbel hashshevua atta, shehagam sheyyitchayyev bah bevo alav hara veyikra el Adonai yislach lo, velo tirbotz bo kol haala, kevan sheasa ma shealav vekibbel haala atta, ella shehitnatztzach miyyitzro yerachamehu osehu, ma sheen ken adam habbeliyyaal sheyyevattel hashshevua atta belibbo shehu makshe atzmo ladaat vegorem raa leatzmo.

Vehinne hagam sheamar hakkatuv baish hahu, hu haddin mishpacha o shevet, uchemo sheggilla hakkatuv levassof keamro (Devarim 29:21) "veamar haddor haacharon vegomer verau et makkot haaretz hahi" vegomer, hare ki lo leish echad yiched onesh haamur, ella gam lerabbim asher yazmu kacha.

rashi: Beula. meyushshevet:
targum: La yitamar lich od shevika ulearich la yitamar od tzadya are lich yitkere avde reuti va ulearich yatva are tehe raava min kodam Adonai vich vearech tityatav:

rashi: Lo yedaem. lo yadu vahem gevurat elohut:
Velo chalak lahem. lo netanam lechelkam; veunkelos tirgem "vela otiva lehon", lo hetivu lahem shum tova; velashon lo chalak — oto eloah shebbacharu lahem lo chalak lahem shum nachala veshum chelek:

Al chomotayich yerushalim. rabbotenu derashuhu kemashmao: malachim hammazkirim et Adonai al churbanah livnotah. may amri? "atta takum terachem tziyyon" (tehillim 102:14), "ki vachar Adonai betziyyon" (tehillim 132:13), kidita bimsechet menachot (menachot paz 1). veyonatan tirgem chomotayich: avot harishonim, hammeginim alenu kachoma:
Hifkadti shomrim. lichtov sefer zichronot shello yishtakkach zechutam millefanay:
Lo yecheshu. millehazkir zechutam lefanay:
Hammazkirim et Adonai. et zechut haavot:
Al domi lachem. al tacharishu:
targum: Ha al ovade avahatach tzadikaya karta dirushelem metaknin natrin kodamay kol yemama vechol lelya tedira la paskin mitamar dachran tavvatich kodam Adonai la fasek lechon:

rashi: Ki chaaretz asher totzi tzimchah vegomer.
targum: Are cheara demafka tzimchah ucheginat shakya dezeruaha meravya ken Adonai elohim yigle zechuta vetushebachta dirushelem lokovel kol ammaya:

rashi: Hakketuva besefer hattora hazze. ulemala hu omer "gam kol choli vechol makka … besefer hattora hazzot"? hazzot — leshon nekeva musav el hattora, hazze — leshon zachar musav el hassefer, veal yede fissuk hatteamim hen nechelakin lishte leshonot, befarashat hakkelalot hattippecha netuna tachat besefer, vehattora hazzot devukim ze laze, lechach amar hazzot, vechan hattippecha netuna tachat hattora, nimtza sefer hattora devukim ze laze, lefichach leshon zachar nofel acharav, shehallashon nofel al hassefer:
ohc: Veamro umacha Adonai et shemo mittachat hashshamayim. da ki shoresh nishmot am bene yisrael yesudatam beharere kodesh tachat hashshamayim, besod "hashshamayim kisi" (yeshaya 66:1), vehanneshamot hem chatzuvot mittachat kisse chevodo yitbarach, vehaven:

Uchevar yadata sod hashshem ki hu hanneshama, uchemo sheheerachnu bimkomot acherim, veamar hakkatuv al hammishtarer bilvavo "umacha Adonai et shemo", shehi nishmato, mishsharshah, shehu tachat hashshamayim, vezo hi keritut hannefesh mishsharshah.

Veamro vehivdilo Adonai leraa. kashe, achar shemmacha Adonai et shemo ma makom lehavedala? achen lefi ma shekkadam lanu ki chol nishmot am bene yisrael shoresh echad lahem, keamro (yeshaya 60:22) "netzer mattaay", uchemo sheramzu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 4:6) befasuk "vayhi kol nefesh yotze yerech yaakov shivim nafesh" (Shemot 1:5), shehagam shehem shivim keraam nefesh, letzad bechinat hashshoresh. laze kesheamar hakkatuv "umacha Adonai et shemo", beer hakkatuv shello yishlot alav chelek hara leabbedo laish hammishtarer belibbo ad sheyyavdilo Adonai, veyagbil hachelek sheyyishlot bo hartzua raa, ki hakkelippa hashsholetet tikkare raa. vechen hi middat Adonai keshennatan reshut lamchabbel magbil lo makom asher yishlot bo. vetze ulemad mimmaase rava (taanit kad:) keshehitriach laAdonai kivyachol laasot nes shetztzivva alav aviv leval yishan bimkomo veshaltu hammechabbelim bemittato velo chutz mimmenna, vehu mittaam ze atzmo.
Veamro "mikkol shivte yisrael". lefi shehannefesh mistabbechet im kol hashshevatim, laze yavdilehu mikkullam leval taggia raato lezulato.

O yomar al ze hadderech "vehivdilo" vegomer, perush, sheachar sheyyimche Adonai et shemo shehi nishmato, yavdilo lartzua haraa, lehummo uleabbedo bechosot hammarim asher muchanim lo, vehu amro "kechol alot" vegomer, lomar sheharaa sheyyishlot Adonai alav, hi raa shekkolelet kol haalot asher nitchakkem hu lehimmalet mimmenna.

rashi: Vayyitteshem Adonai. ketargumo "vetaltelinun", vechen "hinni notsham meal admatam" (Yirmeyahu 12):
Ach ammi hemma. af al pi sheggaluy lefanay sheyyivgedu bi, mikkol makom ammi hem, vahare hem lefanay kvanim asher lo yeshakkeru:
targum: Vaamar beram ami inun benaya dela yeshakrun vahava memre lehon parik:

rashi: Al alamot. shem shel keli shir bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 15:20):
targum: Leshabbacha al yedehon divne korach beruach nevua bizman deitkase avuhon minhon vehinun ishtezvu vaamaru shirata:

rashi: Et hachayyim veet hattov. ze taluy baze — im taase tov hare lecha chayyim, veim taase ra hare lecha hammavet, vehakkatuv mefaresh veholech heach:
Vayyizkor yeme olam moshe ammo. hannavi mitonen veomer belashon techinna: hayyom baggola, zocher ammo et yeme olam, et yeme moshe, uvetzarato hu omer: ayye moshe roenu hammaalenu miyyam suf:
Et roe tzono. dimyon roe hammaale et tzono, ayye hu asher sam bekerev yisrael et ruach kadsho shel hakkadosh baruch hu, velimmedanu chukkim umishpatim:
targum: Vechas al yekar sheme bedil ducheran tavvate demin alma gevuran daavad al yede moshe leame dilma yemar an deaskinun min yama an dedabberinun bemadbera keraaya leane an deashre venehon yat memar neviye kudeshe:

ohc: Leahava et Adonai vegomer. maamar ze samuch im ma shellemala mimmennu, sheamar "lemaan tichye atta vezarecha", vegamar omer "leahava" vegomer, perush, shettaam chefetz bachayyim hu leahava et Adonai lishmoa bekolo vegomer, venatan taam "ki hu chayyecha", ki ma laadam chayyim im lo retzono yitbarach, sheasiyyat retzono hi tesovev sheyyidbak haadam bekono, keamro "uledavka vo", veze hu atzmo hachayyim baolam hazze veorech yamim laolam habba, vehu amro "veorech yamecha".

Veamro lashevet al vegomer. keillu amar velashevet vegomer, vedavar ze gam ken hu mehassagat hashshelemut, ki yeshivat haaretz hi mitzva kolelet kol hattora. tze ulemad mimmaamaram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki.) shekkol haholech bah arba ammot yesh lo chelek laolam habba shekkullo chayyim.
Chassalat parashat nitztzavim

rashi: Vehemma maru. hiknitu, kemo "mamrim heyitem" (Devarim 9:7):
targum: Veinun sarivu veargizu al memar neviye kudeshe veithappech memre lehon livel devav hu agiach kerava behon:

rashi: Asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom leahava. hare hattov, uvo taluy vechayita veravita, hare hachayyim:

ohc: Umal Adonai elohecha vegomer. yesh lehair, achar sheamar lemala "veshavta ad Adonai veshamata bekolo", ma makom lomar od "umal Adonai"? od roani sheomer od achar kach "veatta tashuv" vegomer, shennire shemma shekkadam adayin lo higgia litshuva, veze eno, ki achar shemmal libbo leahava et Adonai bechol levavo uvechol nafsho, en lecha teshuva gedola mizzo.

Achen lefi ma shepperashti befarashat ki tavo (Devarim 28:15) ben beinyan habberachot ben beinyan hakkelalot, sheyyesh shelosha devarim kelaliyyot bemitzvot Adonai: achat hi esek hattora, shenit shemirat mitzvot lo taase, shelishit kiyyum mitzvot ase:

Laze keshebba lomar tikkun hatteshuva sidder shelashtam, keneged teshuvat talmud tora, amar teshuva rishona "veshavta ad Adonai", vegamar omer "veshamata vekolo" shehu talmud tora, velo hizkir immo davar acher, vezo hi hatechalat hatteshuva shetztzarich hashshav asot, veamar kenegdah "veshav Adonai et shevutecha veshav vekibbetzcha" vegomer, keamram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 3 72.) shebbizchut esek hattora yihyu yisrael nigalin. gam amar "al ma avda haaretz" vegomer, "vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati" (yirmeya 9:11-12), laze kesheyyashuvu letalmud tora yekabbetzem Adonai viviem el haaretz asher yarshu vegomer:

Ucheneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase amar "umal Adonai elohecha et levavcha" vegomer, veyadua ki arlat hallev hu asot resha veahavat haresha, shellibbo shel adam mechammadto, uchenegdo amar "umal" vegomer "leahava et Adonai", perush, shettalbish haahava asher tikken becha hattochen beriatcha binimut yedidut chibbat elohecha, veyiched sachar laze sheyyahafoch Adonai kol hatztzarot mealenu al sonenu, keamro "venatan" vegomer "al oyvecha" vegomer:
Ucheneged kiyyum mitzvot ase, amar "veatta tashuv vegomer veasita et kol mitzvotav", hare ze mitzvot ase, veyiched lahem sechar hakeravat hattoelet keamro "vehotircha" vegomer veyashuv lasus vegomer:

rashi: Mi ze ba meedom. nitnabbe hannavi al sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu sheatid laasot nekama beedom, vehu atzmo bichvodo yaharog et sar shellahem techilla, keinyan shenneemar (Yeshayahu 34:5) "ki rivta vashshamayim charbi" veachar kach "al edom tered", venikkar bezaam panav sheharagam hereg rav. vehannavi medabber bilshon milchamot bene adam levushe begadim, uvehargam hereg haddam nittaz al bigdehem, ki ken derech hakketuvim medabberim bashshechina kederech bene adam lesabber et haozen ma shehi yechola lishmoa, vechen (Yechezkel 43:2) "vekolo kekol mayim rabbim", dimma hannavi kol chazak shello lekol mayim rabbim lesabber et haozen kederech sheefshar lah lishmoa, sheen lehavin ulehaazin beruach gevurot elohenu lehashemiah kemot shehi:
Mi ze ba meedom. yisrael omer: mi ze vegomer, uva chamutz begadim tzevuim bedam, vechol davar shehu mitnaetz berecho uvemarito nofel bo leshon 'chimmutz:

Mibbatzra. amru rabbotenu (makkot 12.): shete tauyyot atid sar shel seir litot, kesavur hu shebbatzra hi "betzer bammidbar" (Devarim 4:43) shehayta ir miklat, vetoe, mishshum sheen koletet ella shogeg vehu harag et yisrael mezid. veod yesh midrash aggada (Bereshit Rabba 83 3), al shehispika batzra melech leseir bemot malkah harishon "vayyimloch tachtav yovav ben zerach mibbatzra" (Bereshit 36:33), uvatzra mimmoav hi, keinyan shenneemar "al keriyyot veal batzra" (Yirmeyahu 48:24):

Ze. (shehaya) hadur bilvusho vtzoe veneezar berov kocho, vehakkadosh baruch hu meshivo: ani hu shealta lefanay ledabber betzidkat haavot uvetzidkat doro shel tzara, vetzidkati gam hi immahem, venigleti lihyot rav lehoshia. vehem omrim: maddua adom lilvushecha? maddua begadecha adumim?
targum: Man amar ilen atid leaytaa macha al edom pureana takifa al batzra lemebad pureanut din ame kema dekayem lehon bememre amar ha ana mitgele kema demalelit bezachu sagya kodamay chel lemifrak:

rashi: Tehi lo. hakkelala maate keveged (matzati):
Ulemezach tamid. chagora, vechen "umeziach afikim rippa" (Iyov 12:21) ezor hachazakim pitteach:
targum: Teheve leh hech levush yitatef ulekamor tedira yezarzina:
Utehon kelil dechedva kodam Adonai uchetar detushebcha kodam elahayich:
Vela yifsok dachranhon min kadamohi ad ditaken vead dishave yat yerushelem tushebachta beara:
Veyikron lehon ama dekudesha perikaya dayya velich yitkere teviata karta dela itrechakat:
Elaha lana ruchatzana veushena siata beakta nishtakkach lachada:
Kayam Adonai bimine uvidra tukefe im etten yat ibburich od mechal levaale devavech veim yishtun bene ammaya chamrich dilet beh:
Havu kodam Adonai aykar verommu shemeh ovilu vesovru tikruveta veulu likdamoy ledartoy:
Ma den yismekun turin midam ketilin umeshrin yifkun kachmar bematzera:
Shevacha veshivhora kodamoy ushena vetushebcha bevet makdesheh:
Bidyetuv beel devave laachora yitkelun vihovdun min kodamach:
Echde veevdach bememrach ashabbach shemach ilaa:
Da ovada desatne min Adonai udemallin bishta al nafshi:
Kali kodam Adonai veekbal kali kodam elaha veatzet memri:
Arum rav Adonai umeshabbach lachada didchil hu al kol elahaya:
Are yom pureanuta kodamay ushenat purekan ami metat:
Arum anya vachashicha ana velibbi shefi begavi:
Veat elohim Adonai aved imi min biglal shemach hech tuvach vechasdach petze yati:
Arum kol dachalat ammaya taavata vayay shemaya avad:
Ishteayu beammaya aykareh bechol amaya perishvateh:

bart: Bau leshilo neesru habbamot. dichtiv (Devarim 12) ki lo vatem ad atta el hammenucha, mikkelal dichsheyyavou el hammenucha, habbamot asurot. umenucha zo shilo shehayta sham menucha shello hayu nosim mimmakom lemakom kemo bammidbar:

Bayit shel avanim milmattan viriot milmalan. dichtiv (Shmuel 1 1) vatteviehu vet Adonai‏ shilo, alma bayit haya, uchetiv (tehillim 78) vayyittosh mishkan shilo, allema shel yeriot haya, melammed shello haya sham tikra ella bayit shel avanim millematta viriot millemala:

Umaaser sheni bechol haroe. uleel lo tane maaser sheni, lefi shekkol arba esre shana shehayu baggilgal lo nitchayyevu bemaasrot ad shekkavshu vechilleku. uvechol haroe hayenu bechol makom sheroin mishsham shilo, deamar kera (Devarim 12) hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher tire, bechol makom asher tire i atta maale, aval atta ochel bechol makom sheatta roe:
Kemiddat rabbi eliezer keshera. al dato shel rabbi eliezer deamar beferek ketzad tzolin, dam af al pi sheen basar, hachi nammi kometz af al pi sheen shirayim, kasher lehaketir kometz:
Kemiddat rabbi yehoshua. deamar im en basar en dam, hachi nammi pasul lehakeriv hakkometz. vehu shello nishtayyer davar min hashshirayim shello nitma. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Shello vichli sharet. shello kiddesh hakkometz bichli sharet. aval bitchillat hammincha kulle alma lo felige devae keli, kidamrinan beferek shete hallechem:

Verabbi shimon machshir. taama derabbi shimon mefaresh baggemara, mishshum deamar kera (Vayikra 6) kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham, umiddeakkish rachamana mincha lachattat daavodato bemattana baetzba mammash, shema minna dekometz hammincha nammi im ratza ovdah beyado belo keli. uvilvad sheyyaavod beyado hayemanit, dumeya dechattat shenneemar bo etzba dichtiv beh (sham 4) velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao, vechol makom shenneemar etzba uchehunna eno ella yamin. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Hiktir kumtzah paamayim. chatzi kometz befaam achat vachatzi kometz befaam acheret. vedavka nakat paamayim vetu lo, deen kometz pachut mishshene zetim, vechi paleg leh lishte peamim nimtza sheen haketara befachot mikkazzayit ulefichach keshera, aval im chilleka leshalosh o learba peamim, deaved lehu haketara pechuta mikkazzayit, pesula:

Hare ellu vaase. deshamma taviu et olotechem, demashma aval lo babbama, velav habba mikkelal ase, ase. i nammi, ase vehevium laAdonai, velo taase dehishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha, vechol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal, eno ella lo taase:

Veen chayyavin alehem karet. kevan shehikdisham bishat hetter habbamot, sheen hammakriv bachutz chayyav karet ella al karban sheim hikrivo bachutz bishat hekdesho haya chayyav, dumeya demidbar, divcharet dishchute chutz ketiv (Vayikra 17) chukkat olam tihye zot lahem, zot lahem veen acheret lahem:

Hikdishan bishat issur habbamot. mehahi shata karinan behu vehevium laAdonai, vechevan shehimtin ad shello yachol lekayyemo nitbattel haase al yado. aval lav vecharet lekka, deazhara veonesh bishat hakerava chetive, vahare hutteru habbamot:

Kemin gad yon lashshiloach. makom birushalayim sheheemidu vo malche yevanim avoda zara, vehaya oto makom rachok min hashshiloach shiur shete tevilot ushene sippugim. kemiggad yon, leshon haorchim laggad shulchan (yeshaya 65). shilloach, shem hannahar, kedichtiv (sham 8) yaan ki maas haam hazze et me hashshiloach:
Metamme mishkav umoshav. dechashvina la kishte reiyyot:

Ella im ken yesh bah kede shalosh. kegon kemiggad yon lashshiloach, deaz necheshav kezav gamur afillu leinyan karban. aval beachat merubba chishtayim, en cholkin otah, vechiriyya achat hi chashuva. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Metamme et hammishkav. vehu haddin lemoshav:

Omed yoshev shochev. dichtiv (Vayikra 15) kol hammishkav asher yishkav alav hazzav yitma, uchetiv (sham) al hakkeli asher hi yoshevet alav, en li ella vizman sheshshachav al hammishkav veyashav al hammoshav. shachav al hammoshav veyashav al hammishkav, amad, nitla, nishan, minnayin. talmud lomar yitma yetamme, ribba. vechullan nikrain midras:

Vehammishkav metamme et haadam vechulei‏ omed yoshev shochev nitle. shehattahor bechaf moznayim vehammishkav hattame bechaf sheniyya, vechara hammishkav hattame, venitle hattahor. venitle deresha, kegon shehazzav bechaf moznayim umoshavot bechaf sheniyya vecharu hen, temein, dehashta hazzav nitle ucheillu hu yoshev alehen:
Letamme vegadim. hu haddin kol kelim shennogea bahen ad shello ferash, chutz meadam uchele cheres:
Bemagga uvemassa. im naga bammishkav hattame, o shennesao:
Ella letzorech hammoed. shehakkone tzarich lahem bammoed, battim leshev bahem, avadim leshammesho, behema lishchita:
O letzorech hammocher. shetztzarich lemaot lehotzian letzorech yom tov:
En mefannim. kelim o tevua:
Mibbayit. ze levayit acher rachok mimmennu, mippene hattorach:
Aval mefanne lachatzero. levayit acher shebbeoto chatzer, detzina have. aval mibbayit levayit derech reshut harabbim lo:
Veen meviin kelim mibbet haumman. vehanne mile kelim sheenan letzorech hammoed, aval kelim shehen letzorech hammoed kegon karim uchesatot vechosot vekitoniyyot share:
Veim choshesh lahem. shemma yigganvu mibbet haumman, o im tzarich haumman lischaro veen baal hakkeli maamino ki yare shemma yishal mimmennu sechar peullato paam sheniyya:
Roin et hannegaim bammoed lehakel. sheim tahor hu omer lo hakkohen tahor atta, shessimcha hi lo:
Aval lo lehachemir. sheim tame hu, yishtok, velo yetammeennu veyatzrichennu latzet chutz lammachane:

Lo lehakel velo lehachemir. mittoch shennizkak liroto im hu tahor kede lehakel alav, hu nizkak lehachemir, sheim hu tame tzarich lomar lo tame atta, kedichtiv (Vayikra 13) letaharo o letammeo, sheen kohen rashshay lishtok, umutav lo shello yirehu hakkohen kelal:
Melakket adam atzmot aviv veimmo. bammoed, kede lekavram bemakom hagun:
Shessimcha hi lo. kesheroe otam shekkovran bekivre avotav. veen halacha kerabbi meir bishtehen:

Lo yearer al meto. lo yavi safdan learer al meto shemmet ze yamim rabbim, lachzor al kerove hammet kederech shechozer hassafdan shetztzoek veomer bou bechu immi kol mare lev, umi shellibbo dave alav holech umaspid al kerovo:
Lo yaspidennu. lo yiskor safdan al meto shemmet lo beotah shaa:

Kodem laregel sheloshim yom. tamid. deamre tama baggemara shedderech bene adam lichnos maot letzorech haregel kodem laregel sheloshim yom mikki shama sheddorshim behilchot haregel, veshemma yitten hammaot shekkinnes letzorech haregel lassafdan veyimmana missimchat haregel. veit deamre sheen hammet mishtakkeach min hallev ella leachar sheloshim yom achar hespedo:
Mi shehafach. derech bene adam shemmehappechin hazzetim betoch hammaatan shehem tzevurim bo, kesherotzim lehachenisan levet habbad. vei lo massik lehu labbad litchon leachar shehafachan pasde:
Veero evel. sheasur bimlacha:
O shehituhu foalim. shello bau limlachto. vehiggia hammoed:

Toen. al hazzetim kora shel bet habbad paam rishona umachbid, kede sheyyazuvu ketzat velo yafsidu, aval lo befaam sheniyya mishshum detu lo pasde. umehacha shaminan didvarim hammuttarim bammoed asur laavel laasotam beyado bime evlo, middekatane veero evel umechamat haevel ikkev ad hammoed toen kora rishona bammoed, aval bime evlo haya asur liton beyado afillu kora rishona. aval acherim toanim lo:
Zolef. shofech hazzetim al gabbe bet habbad. vechol mide deshafich karuy zilluf:
Vegomer. sechitatam veitztzuram bevet habbad:
Vegaf. sotem pi hechaviyyot. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Temein. ben kara hazzav, ben karu ochalin umashkin, nitmeu tumat hesset:

Uvammet hakkol tahor. ben moshav umishkav, ben ochalim umashkin, ben kara hammet ben karu hem, dechol tumot hammassitot tehorot, chutz mehesseto shel zav. veim karu hen, nammi tehorim, dechol shehammet nissa alav kegon bechaf moznayim levad meohel, tahor, chutz min haadam, devizman shemmachria et hammet, tame mippene shehissito, kidamrinan beferek batra denidda (daf 69), attu met mi lo nitma vemassa:

Maddaf. leshon tuma kalla, kedichtiv (Vayikra 26) kol ale niddaf. verambam peresh, maddaf milleshon recho nodef, shereach tumat hazzav holechet lemerachok letamme chol hakkelim sheal gabbav af al pi shello naga bahem. aval lo chetumat hakkelim shettachtav, shekkelim al gabbe hazzav, af al pi sheyyesh devarim chotztzim benam leven hazzav, kullam temeim tuma kalla letamme ochalim umashkin, aval lo letamme adam vechelim. veillu kelim shettachtav afillu hen mea ze al gav ze, hattachton shebbechullam tame tuma chamura letamme adam letamme vegadim kemo haelyon:
Ma sheen hammet metamme. demittachtav afillu tehe tuma vokaat veyoredet, mikkol makom en mishkav umoshav shettachtav metamme adam letamme vegadim:

Veal gabbav maddaf. nehi demet nammi metamme chelim sheal gabbav tumat maddaf letamme ochalim umashkin, detuma vokaat veola, mikkol makom im [haya hammet baaliyya, vehammishkavot vehammoshavot babbayit ad sheme hakkora, vehannesarim nichpafim mikkoved hammet umachbidin al hammishkavot, o] hammet babbayit samuch lishme kora, vehammishkavot baaliyya, venichpafim hannesarim mikkoved hammishkavot umachbidim al hammet, ki hay gavna bazzav tame mittachtav letamme adam letamme vegadim, veal gabbav letamme ochalim umashkin, uvammet ben al gabbav ben mittachtav tahor:

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash. deen laatzeret tashlumin kol shiva lekarban, batla leh torat haregel, vehave keshabbat sheenah mafseket. aval bizman hammikdash shemmi shello chag beyom rishon shel atzeret haya chogeg veholech kol shiva, kechag hammatztzot, haya atzeret kechag hammatztzot af leinyan avelut. umaskana demilta leinyan pesak hahalacha, daatzeret bazzeman hazze kargalim, verosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim kargalim. umi shemmet lo met kodem echad meellu afillu shaa echat, batla mimmennu gezerat shiva. veim met shiva yamim kodem echad miyyamim tovim ellu, batla mimmennu gezerat sheloshim. umi shemmet lo met shaa achat kodem chag hassukkot batla mimmennu gezerat shiva kidamran, veshivat yeme haregel olin leminyan sheloshim. veaf al gav ditnan regalim mafsikin veenan olin, en olin leminyan shiva, aval olin leminyan sheloshim, hare arbaa asar yom, ushemini atzeret hu regel bifne atzmo, venechshav keillu hu shiva yamim, hare esrim veechad yom, mone od tisha yamim ad sheloshim vedayyo. ugezerat shiva deamran hu sheavel kol shivat hayyamim asur birchitza bechammin afillu miktzat gufo, uvetzonen kol gufo, veasur bechibbus begadav, uvesicha, uvinilat hassandal, uvetashmish hammitta, uvaasiyyat melacha, uvishilat shalom. vechayyav baatifat harosh, uvichfiyyat hammitta, shettihyena kol hammittot shebbeveto kefuyot al gabbe karka veyishan bahem velo al mitta zekufa, veasur littol tzipparnav bichli, velo sear sefamo vaafillu meakkev alav et haachila, veasur likrot battora, ben battora shebbichtav ben battora shebbeal pe, velo yishlol hakkera shealav. ugezerat sheloshim hi shemmishshiva vead tashlum sheloshim asur lilbosh beged chadash, o beged lavan megohatz, veasur betisporet, uvisudat harshut, velalechet bischora im chaverav, velissa ishsha acheret im yesh lo ishsha uvanim, velo yeache hakkera shealav:
Hanneger. yated hannautz achore haddelet bannekev shebbaaskuppa:
Manul. shessogrim bo happetach:
Mashot. shemmanhigin bo et hassefina. uleshon mikra hu, kol tofse mashot, bichezkel [27]:
Kelet. iggul shel etz shessaviv larechayim hattachtona lekabbel hakkemach hannitchan shello yippol laaretz, umittaltel hu:
Veal socha shekkochah ra. veomedet beilan shekkocho yafe:
Temein. dechol hane en kochan yafe, vechoach hekkesh hazzav behu chashiv hesset:
Metaharim baellu. ashshidda teva umigdal kae. lehachi teninhu tanna kamma lechodayhu. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya verabbi shimon:
Veishsha reutah kina. umiddichtiv velammedna, alma kina, achat omeret vachavertah ona:

Aval leatid lavo omer billa hammavet lanetzach. sheyyevalla hakkadosh baruch hu et hammavet, vechullan onot shira, sheen mita veen dima. venaktinan lehay kera hacha, mishshum al taamod bedavar ra [lachen raa lesayyem betov]:
Hazzav vehazzava. shehikrivu vachutz, betoch yeme safran:
Vehayyoledet. shehikriva betoch melot:
Peturin. sheen mitkabbelin lo lechova velo lindava:
Vaashamam. baggemara parech, zav vezava veyoledet bene asham ninhu, umeshane tane metzora bahadayhu, shehammetzora mevi asham:
Olotehen veshalmehen. baggemara parech, hane vene shelamim ninhu, umeshane, tane nazir bahadayhu, shennazir mevi shelamim:
Bachutz chayyavin. shehen mitkabbelot bifnim nedava lishman leachar shehikrivu chattatam vehammetzora et ashamo:

Mibbesar chattat mibbesar asham kulei. dechol hane neechalim lakkohanim veenan kerevim legabbe mizbeach, verachamana amar (Vayikra 17) asher yaale ola o zevach, ma ola shehi kereva al gabbe mizbeach, af kol shehu karev al gabbe mizbeach:
Mibbesar kadshe kadashim. kivse atzeret shehem shalme tzibbur veyesh lahem torat kadshe kadashim:
Hayyotzek. hashshemen al hammincha:
Habbolel. happotet. habbolel hammincha vashshemen. ufottah pittim:
Hammenif. hammaggish. shemmenif et hammincha shetteuna tenufa. umaggishah bachutz. hammincha shehi teuna haggasha bifnim bekeren deromit maaravit kedichtiv (sham 2) vehiggishah el hammizbeach:
Hamesadder. lechem happanim al hashshulchan:
Patur. deamar kera asher yaale ola o zevach, ma haalaa shehu gemar avoda, af kol shehu gemar avoda, yatzu ellu sheen echad mehen gemar avoda:

En chayyavin alav mishshum zarut. im asa zar achat mikkol haavodot hallalu, kegon shebbalal o patat vechulei. vechen tame, o mechussar begadim, o mi sheeno rechutz yadayim veraglayim, eno chayyav mita af al pi shennifsal oto davar sheavad bo:
Zar veonen utevul yom kulei. kullehu meforashim beferek 2‏ dizvachim. umochchinan lehu mikkerae daavodatan pesula:
Arel. kohen shemmetu echav mechamat mila:
Yoshev. devainan laamod lesharet:
Al gabbe chelim kulei. devainan shello yihye davar chotzetz beno uven haritzpa:
Ben betera omer yachazir. hakkometz letoch hammincha:

Veyachazor veyikmotz bayyamin. vehu haddin lechol hanach pesulim dachashiv bematnitin sevira leh leven betera sheim avar echad mehen vekamatz yachazir hakkometz limkomo veyachazor kohen kasher veyikmotz. veen halacha keven betera:

Ala veyado tzeror. nimtza kometz chaser mekom hatztzeror o gargir melach o koret shel levona. dekodem kemitza borer kol hallevona letzad echad vekometz veachar kach melakket otam venotnah im hakkometz vesoref hakkol. veim nizdammen betoch hakkometz gargir melach o koret shel levona hare hakkometz chaser kede mekom hakkoret:
Mevoratz. male vegadush:
Shekkematzo verashe etzbeotav. shello peshatan al kol pas yado:

Poshet et etzbeotav al pas yado. machnis tzidde etzbeotav bakkemach umachnis hakkemach letoch yado umochek beetzba ketanna shello yetze hakkemach chutz lakkemitza umochek baggudal shello yetze hakkemach chutz laetzba. veze haya tzarich laasot beminchat machavat umarcheshet demaasehen afuyin uleachar afiyyatan pottan vekometz, vei efshar lefattan dakkot kol kach shello yihyu yotzot chutz lakkometz, hilkach mochek baggudal millemala uveetzba ketanna millematta. vezo hayta meavodot kashot shebbammikdash, divkoshi gadol yachol lehashevot shello yehe lo chaser velo yater. verambam katav, shennidchu divre haomer shezzo avoda kasha shebbammikdash, vehu mefaresh vekometz kidkamtze eynashe haamur baggemara [daf 11], dehaynu shemmemalle kappo mimmennu kederech shebbene adam memalleim yedehem mimma shellokchim beyadam. vaani omer sheen perush kidkamtze eynashe ella shemmachnis tzidde etzbeotav bakkemach umachnis hakkemach betzidde etzbeotav letoch yado, aval eno notel kemach ella melo shelosh etzbeotav al pas yado velo yoter, uchede shello yihye mevoratz umevatzbetz veyotze, mochek millematta beetzba ketanna umillemala baggudal. velo nidchu kelal divre haomer shezzo avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash, veshitat haggemara kidvaray. vechen pershuha kol rabbotay:
Marish. kora gedola shebbonim babbira verashe korot haggag kullan semuchot aleha, vehi munnachat al gabbe ammudim:
Malben. kemin ribbua shel korot kevuot baaretz:
Tzinnor. marzev shel mayim:
Af al pi shehu asuy bachavalim. sheeno kavua baaretz ella kashur bachavalim veen kocho yafe kol kach:
Veal hayyam. hekkef shel etz shehakkemach mitkabbetz bo bishat hattechina:
Itzterubbal. iggul shel etz shemmaamidin harechayim alav. ushenehen kevuim hen:
Chamor shel rechayim shel yad. binyan shel etzim sheharechayim shel yad kevuim bahen:
Usea shel rechayim. midda gedola ukevua vakkarka:

Korat habballanin. kora shebbaal hammerchatz yoshev aleha. vechol hane im hikkish alehen hazzav venafal hakkikkar shel teruma mikkoach hahekkesh, tahor, dechochan yafe vela chashiv hesset. uvekorat habballanim nechleku. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Bau lenov ulegivon. keshecharva shilo lesof shelosh meot veshivim chaser achat shehaya hammishkan sham, venilkach haaron bime eli, bau lenov, vecharva nov bime shaul uvau legivon. vechol yeme nov vegivon hayu chamishshim vesheva shana, vechol zeman ze hayu habbamot muttarot, derachamana amar beissur habbamot ki lo vatem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala, menucha zo shilo, nachala zo yerushalayim, velamma chillekan hakkatuv ella kede litten hetter labbamot ben zo lezo:

Kadashim kallim bechol are yisrael. vehu haddin lemaaser sheni, shehare hikkishan hakkatuv, dichtiv (sham) lo tuchal leechol bisharecha maasar degancha vegomer, vechol nedarecha asher tiddor, bizman shekadashim kallim teunim havaat makom af maaser sheni taun havaat makom, bizman shekadashim kallim bechol are yisrael af maaser sheni bechol are yisrael:
Umi shennishal lechacham. shennadar shello lechabbes begadav, venishal lechacham bammoed vehittir lo nidro:
Umitpechot yadayim. shemmenaggevim bahem yadayim bishat achila:

Umitpechot sapparim. kesut shennotnim hassapparim lammistapper ben ketefav mippene hassear. ucheshebba legalleach leellu hashshenuyim bammishna shehen muttarin legalleach bammoed tzarich lechabbesah tamid:
Mitpechot hassappagin. shemmenaggevin bahen kesheyyotzin min hammerchatz:

Vechol haolim mittuma letohora. bammoed, muttarim lechabbes bigdehem. uchele pishtan afillu shel kol adam muttar lechabbesan bammoed, mippene shehen tzerichin kibbus tadir, vaafillu hammechubbasim erev haregel mittanfe miyyad utzerichim kibbus betoch haregel, hilkach lo gazru behu. umi sheen lo ella chaluk echad, afillu sheeno shel pishtan muttar lechabbes bammoed, vehu sheomed arum bishat kevisato im ezor bematnav bilvad lechassot besar erva, shezze mochiach sheen lo ella hechaluk hazze shehu mechabbes bilvad:
Veshole fishtano. kol ma shemmaale min hammayim karuy shole:
Im kivvenu melachtan bammoed yovedu. bet din meabbedim oto mamon, veosim oto hefker:

Kiddushe ishsha. kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres hare at mekuddeshet li, umekaddesh bo haishsha af al pi sheen bo sheve peruta. ulefichach muttar lichtov bammoed, shemmityare shemma yekaddemennu acher, vahava leh davar haaved:
Gitin. sherotze latzet beshayyara, veim eno kotev achshav tishshaer zot aguna:
Veshovarim. sheim yomar hallove lo efra chovcha im en li shover mimmecha, shomin lo, veyelech ledarko, venimtza ze mafsid et meotav:
Deyateke. mattenat shechiv mera. uferush deyateke, da tehe lemekam velihyot, sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu:
Mattana. mattenat bari. vei lo kativ lehu mafsid hamekabbel, deshemma yachzor bo hannoten:

Uferozbulin. shello tishmot sheviit veyafsid et meotav. perozbul, peroz bule uferoz bute, kelomar takkana laashirim shello yaavru al ma shekkatuv battora (Devarim 15) hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal, vetakkana laaniyyim sheyyimtzeu lilvot. bule ashirim. bute aniyyim. vehillel tikken perozbul, shetar shekkotvin bo moser ani lachem peloni ufeloni haddayyanin shekkol shetar sheyyesh li al peloni egvennu kol zeman sheertze, veshuv en sheviit meshammetet halevaato, dahave keillu gavu bet din et chovo, veshuv lo karinan beh lo yiggos et reehu:
Iggerot shum. sheshshamu bet din nichse love venatnu lammalve:
Iggerot mazon. shemmachru bet din et hakkarka limzon haishsha vehabbanot, vechotvin maase bet din al ze. i nammi mi shekkibbel alav lazun et bat ishto:
Meunim. ketanna shehissiuha immah veacheha, yechola lemaen bevaalah velomar i efshi bifloni baali, veyotza belo get. ushetar shekkotvin leedut davar ze, nikra shetar meunim:
Shitre verurin. shebbarru lahem dayyanin, ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad, vechotvin shetar, shello yachzeru bahen habbaale dinim:
Ugezerot bet din. pesak din sheppasku haddayyanim:
Iggerot shel rashut. tzavve hashshilton. kemo veal titvadda larashut, heuu zehirim barashut. veyesh mefarshin iggerot shel sheilat shalom shekkotvim ben adam lachavero:

Hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan. af al gav demitzva latet shene chutin shel techelet ushene chutin shel lavan, o chut echad shel techelet ushelosha chutim shel lavan, afillu hachi en ze meakkev et ze, veim natan arbatan [shel techelet o arbatan] shel lavan, yatza:

Tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh. rambam katav, davka sheshshetehen metzuyin etzlo, aval im en metzuya etzlo ella achat mehen, lo yaniach haachat ad sheyyimtza haacheret, gazrinan shemma yite veyismoch al achat tamid. veze delo kehilchata, deman deamar hachi baggemara [menachot 44.] hadar beh mikkoach ma shehikshu lo veella man delet leh tarte mitzvot chada mitzva nammi lo laaved, bitmiyya. vahalacha, ben sheshshenehen metzuyin etzlo ben sheen metzuyin etzlo, enan meakkevot zo et zo, vechen horu kol rabbotay halacha lemaase:
Hassolet vehashshemen. shel minchat nesachim:
En meakkevin et hayyayin. shel nesachim. sheim heviu et hayyayin belo solet veshemen, menassecho:
Hammattanot shel mizbeach hachitzon. kegon arba mattanot shel chattat:
En meakkevot zo et zo. sheim lo natan ella achat, kipper. dichtiv (Devarim 12) vedam zevachecha yishshafech, sheficha achat mashma:

Kol hannissa al gabbe hazzav. elyono shel zav vaafillu lo naga bo hazzav, vaafillu yesh devarim harebe chotztzim beno leven hazzav, hakkol tame, dichtiv (sham) vehannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav, may tachtav, ilema tachtav dezav, hayenu mishkav, ella bechol asher yihye hazzav tachtav, dehaynu elyono shel zav, venoheg bechol davar, afillu vemidi deen regilut lihyot alav, velo havu cheen tachtav, deen noheg ella vemidi dachazi leh:

Chutz min harauy lemishkav ulemoshav. vehu haddin lemerkav. aval sheeno rauy, tahor, kegon im kafa sea sheenah asuya lishiva veyashav aleha, yachol yehe tame moshav, talmud lomar (sham) vehayyoshev al hakkeli asher yeshev alav hazzav, ma shemmeyuchad lishiva, yatza ze sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu:
Nidbach. shurat binyan hachoma. kemo nidbachin di even gelal (beezra 6):
Hattahor millemala. al hannidbach umachbid al etzbao shel zav, dehashta have nissa al gabbe hazzav venechshav av hattuma:
Metamme shenayim ufosel echad. metamme rishon vesheni, ufosel shelishi batteruma:

Perash. sheyyarad hattahor min hannidbach, o shessillek hazzav etzbao mittachat hannidbach. metamme hattahor echad ufosel echad, lefi sheen hattahor ella rishon mikkevan shepperash, detu lo metamme vegadim, veose sheni ushelishi batteruma:
Hattame milmala. al hannidbach, veetzba hattahor tachat hannidbach, umachbid hattame alav, hare hazzav nissa alav, lefichach metamme shenayim ufosel echad:
Vehammaddaf. kol kelim sheenam mishkav umoshav maddaf kare lehu:
Milmalan. shel nidbach, veetzba hazzav millematta, enam ella rishon:
Metammein echad ufoslim echad. uleachar sheppershu nammi chach dina:
Pershu metammein shenayim ufoslim echad. hammishkav umoshav leolam av hattuma af al pi sheppershu:
Tehorim. kidamrinan shekkol shehazzav nissa alav, tahor, chutz mimmishkav umoshav vehaadam:
Ribba shamnah. sheshshiur hashshemen log lechol issaron. veim ribba, shennatan shene luggin o yoter leissaron dachazu lishte menachot, pasul:
Chissar shamnah. pachot millog shemen leissaron solet:

Chissar levonatah. shello natan bah ella koret echad shel levona. aval im yesh bah shene koratin keshera, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) et kol hallevona asher al hammincha, kol, mashma afillu koret echad, dechol mashma kol dehu kedichtiv (Melachim 2 4) en leshifchatcha chol babbayit. et, lerabbot od koret echad, hare shenayim. veillu ribba levonatah lo katane, delo pasal ella kesheribba yoter al shene komatzim deaz ribba yoter midday:
Leechol sheyareha vachutz. chutz laazara:

O lehaketir kumtzah bachutz. demachashava poselet ben shechashav al achilat adam ben shechashav al achilat mizbeach, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) veim heachol yeachel, bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber, achat laachilat adam veachat laachilat mizbeach, vehahu kera bemachashava mayre dichtiv (sham) hammakriv oto lo yechashev, bishat hakerava hu nifgal veeno nifgal bayyom hashshelishi, alma bemachashava mayre shechashav alav leachlo bayyom hashshelishi:

Pesula. demachashevet chutz limkomo poselet bikmitzat hammincha kemo shepposelet bishchitat hazzevach. uma shepposel bezevach bashshechita bekabbalat haddam baholacha bizrikat haddam, posel hammincha bakkemitza bannetina bichli sharet baholacha behaketarat hakkometz ulevona, arbaa keneged arbaa. vehakkometz vehallevona atzman chashuvim gabbe mincha kemo haddam vehaemurim etzel hazzevach. usheyare mincha hanneechalim, kivsar hazzevach hanneechol. uveferek 2‏ dizvachim meforashim kol hane pesule vehatam yalfinan lehu kullehu mikkerae:
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol. kegon shirayim:
Davar sheddarko lehaketir. kegon hakkometz. aval im chashav leechol hakkometz o lehaketir hashshirayim chutz lizmanno, lo pasal, divtela dato etzel kol adam:
Uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir. hakkometz: kehilchato. keillu haya kasher, shello yehe sham shum pesul ella happiggul bilvad. aval im yesh bo pesul acher eno chashuv yoter piggul veen bo karet:
Kamatz bishtika. shello chashav shum machashevet pesul bishat kemitza:
Venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno. kelomar, shebbishloshet avodot hallalu chashav al hashshirayim leachlan chutz lizmanno:

Hannogea bazzav. uchele shetef bemagga. dechi hechi deadam hannogea bazzav metamme vegadim bishat maggao, kach metamme chol kelim shennogea bahen bishat maggao vazzav, chutz meadam uchele cheres, detanya vetorat kohanim, minnayin laasot shear kelim kivgadim, talmud lomar (Vayikra 15) vetame. yachol yetamme adam uchele cheres, talmud lomar beged, beged hu metamme veeno metamme adam uchele cheres. vedavka vishat maggao vazzav. aval perash, lo, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) veish asher yigga bemishkavo yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame, bishat maggao metamme vegadim. perash, eno metamme vegadim:
Aval lo vemassa. im bishat maggao vazzav nasa vegadim velo naga bahen, tehorim:
Kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao. kegon hannogea bezav vezava veyoledet, uvemaaynotehem, bemishkavan, uvemoshavan:
Metamme ochalim. lihyot techilla, mippene shehu nechshav keav hattuma bishat maggao, kevan deamra tora shehu metamme vegadim:
Veet hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot. aval gufo shel adam, eno metamme, kidkatane sefa sheeno metamme adam uchele cheres:

Leachar perishato. mimmetammeav metamme et hammashkin lihyot techilla. veaf al pi sheeno ella rishon lattuma, ose hammashkin techilla, daafillu sheni lattuma metamme mashkin lihyot techilla. lefi shehen alulin lekabbel tuma veenan tzerichin hechsher kemo hoochalim, gazru vahen sheyyihyu leolam techilla, gezera mishshum mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz shehem techilla min hattora:
Vehoochalim vehayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot. dechevan deferash mimmetammeav, eno ella rishon bealma:
Miuto meakkev et rubbo. sheim chaser kol shehu, pasul, deamar rachamana melo kumtzo:
Haissaron. mincha shehi pechuta meissaron afillu kol shehu, pesula:
Hayyayin. chatzi hahin lappar, ushelishit hahin laayil, ureviit hahin lakkeves. vechen hashshemen ben leminchat nesachim shehu keshiur hayyayin, ben leminchat nedava shehu log echad shemen:
Hassolet vehashshemen. shel mincha:
Meakkevim ze et ze. dichtiv (sham 2) miggirsah umishshamnah:
Hakkometz vehallevona meakkevim ze et ze. dichtiv (sham 6) veherim mimmennu bekumtzo vegomer‏ al kol levonatah:
Hakkover et meto. shemmet lo met kodem haregel, venahag avelut kodem haregel shelosha yamim:

Batla mimmennu gezerat shiva. aval lo batla hemennu gezerat sheloshim, dehaynu issur tisporet, umone achar haregel sheloshim yom im hashshelosha sheavru kevar min hashsheloshim. ufesak halacha, shehakkover et meto afillu shaa achat kodem haregel batla mimmennu gezerat shiva:
Shemona. yamim kodem haregel, hoil venichnas echad mime haggilluach kodem laregel, ate regel umevattel et hashshear legamre:
Shabbat ola. shabbat shebbime evlo ola leminyan shiva:
Veenah mafseket. sheenah mevattelet et hashshear, ella yoshev umitabbel achar shabbat:

Hargalim mafsikin veenam olim. im nahag avelut kodem haregel, haregel mafsik umevattel gezerat sheloshim. veim lo nahag avelut kodem haregel ella hitchil aveluto baregel, en yeme haregel olim leminyan shiva, aval olin leminyan sheloshim. vetama deshabbat ola lecheshbon shivat yeme avelut, mishshum didvarim shebbetzina noheg bah, kegon tashmish hammitta, uferiat harosh, sheasur begilluy harosh, urechitza bechammin, shehaavel asur bahen beshabbat. aval haregel en shum din middine avelut noheg bo, lefichach mafsik legamre. veim lo chal avelut kelal kodem haregel, kegon shennikbar hammet betoch haregel, eno ole leminyan shiva, umatchil limnot shiva achar haregel:
Uvinvela uvemerkav. kol hane bemassa bilvad metammein begadim velo vemagga, hilkach adam hannogea bahen af al pi shello ferash eno ella rishon, umetamme echad ufosel echad:
Kol hannogea. kegon ochalim vechelim. daafillu veotan sheadam hannogea bahen metamme shenayim ufosel echad, kelim hannogim bahen metammeim echad ufoslin echad vaafillu vishat maggao:
Chutz min haadam. deyesh mehen deim naga bahen o nasa dimtamme shenayim ufosel echad, ki hane daamaran leel:
Perash. afillu adam, bechullehu metamme echad ufosel echad, dechevan deferash eno ella rishon:
Kamatz chutz limkomo. chashav bishat kemitza leechol hashshirayim chutz laazara:
Natan bakkeli hillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno. uveachat mishsheloshet avodot hallalu chashav al hashshirayim leachlan chutz lizmanno:

Minchat chote ukenaot. yesh bahen od pesul acher hammotzian mide piggul, kegon shello lishman, deamrinan beresh pirkin difsulot im kematzan shello lishman, usheloshet shear haavodot chashav alehen chutz lizmannan, o afillu harishona chutz lizmannah vehashshear shello lishman, hotzio mide piggul:

O shekkamatz o natan bakkeli o holich o hiktir shello lishman. kelomar e zo meellu sheasa shello lishman vehashshear al menat leechol lashshirayim chutz lizmanno lo karav hammattir kemitzvato veen bashshirayim karet:

Kazzayit bachutz kazzayit lemachar. chashav beachat min haavodot shete machashavot chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo. vead hasheta ayrinan bishte avodot shechashav beachat chutz lizmanno uveacheret chutz limkomo, veachshav mayre shechashav bishtehen baavoda achat. ulerabbi yehuda itzterich, delo tema bishte avodot hu defaleg rabbi yehuda devatar kammayta azlinan, aval bachada avoda mode, kamashma lan:
Kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz. af al pi shechashav techilla lechutz lizmanno hotziatto sheniyya mide karet:
Amar rabbi yehuda ze hakkelal kulei. rabbi yehuda paleg attanna kamma ben baavoda achat ben bishte avodot. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman. kegon shehitnaddev minchat marcheshet veheviah, ukematzah hakkohen leshem machavat:

Kesherot. umaktir hakkometz usheyareha neechalim. shekkemitzat hammincha bimkom shechitat hakkarban omedet, ucheshem shekkol hazzevachim shennishchatu shello lishman kesherim kidyalfinan mikkera beresh massechet zevachim, hachi nammi kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot:

Ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova. hava matze lematne velo alu labbealim leshem chova, veha dekatane ella demashma dechol dinam kimnachot kesherot ella davar ze, leashmeinan deasur leshannoye bah shinnuy acher, sheim avar ukematzah shello lishmah asur latet hakkometz bichli sharet shello lishmah:
Shello alu labbealim leshem chovato. velo yatza yede nidro vetzarich lehavi mincha acheret leshem marcheshet:
Chutz mimminchat chote. kegon mincha habbaa al tumat mikdash vekadashav, im lo tassig yado lishte torim:

Uminchat kenaot. shel sota. sheim kematzan shello lishman, kegon leshem nedava, o natan bichli sharet et hakkometz shello lishmo, o halach o hiktir shello lishmo, o chashav beachat min haavodot hallalu hareni oved lishman veshello lishman. ellu menachot pesulot veen sheyarehen neechalim. vetaama have mishshum deminchat chote chattat karye rachamana. uvachattat ketiv veshachat otah lechattat, velakach middam hachattat, shettehe shechita ulekicha dehaynu kabbalat haddam leshem chattat. uminchat kenaot hoil uchetiv bah avon dichtiv minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon, kachattat shavyu rabbanan. uminchat haomer, af al gav delav minchat chote hi velav minchat kenaot hi, kematzah shello lishmah pesula mehaketir, veen sheyareha neechalim, hoil uvaa lehattir hechadash velo hittira. vechol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot ditnan bematnitin, davka bimnachot sheen lahem zeman kavua ayre, velo beminchat haomer shekkava lah zeman:
O shello lishman velishman. delo tema lishman veshello lishman hu difsula, ditfos lashon acharon, aval shello lishman velishman kesherot, ka mashma lan:
Hahedyot tofer kedarko. hedyot mikkere kol sheeno yodea lechavven safa labbeged shettehe shava umechuvvenet bo, ella meakkem lechan ulechan veosehu rachav bemakom ze vekatzar bemakom acher:
Machliv. ose tefirot keen shinne hakkelev, sheenan shavin zo keneged zo ella achat lemala veachat lematta:
Mesargin et hammittot. orgin otan bachavalin sheti vaerev:
Memattechin. im haya arug ze yamim rabbim verafu hachavalim, memattechin, aval lo mesargin. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Vehaavoda babbechorot. dichtiv (Shemot 24) vayyishlach et naare vene yisrael, ellu habbechorot shehaavoda vahem:

Mishshehukam hammishkan neesru habbamot. dichtiv (Vayikra 17) veel petach ohel moed lo hevio, mikkelal divohel moed tale issura. vedavka leyisrael neesru habbamot, aval nachrim muttarim lehakeriv lashshamayim bechol makom, vaafillu vazzeman hazze. veasur leyisrael lihyot shelucham lehakeriv velo lesayyeam. aval lehorot lahem seder hakerava share:
Betoch habbor. chafira shettachat haggat mesuyyedet besid lekabbel hayyayin:
Limmudim. nesarim shel etz. kelomar mechasse oto sham binsarim shello yachmitz, velo yishlehu min habbor. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Megifin. sogrim et haddelet:
O fotchim. oto yachdav hazzav vehattahor:
Ad sheyyehe ze megif. leolam en kan tuma, ad sheyyehe ze moshech liftoach veze moshech lisgor, sheen mannichim ze laze:

Ad sheyyehe hattahor maale et hattame. veaz bigde hattahor temeim midras, shekkoved hattame al hattahor venishan alav, uvegadav shel tahor temeim midras. aval tame maale et hattahor, en mishenet hattame al hattahor, veen begadav shel tahor temeim midras. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mafshilin bachavalin. hazzav vehattahor yachdav godlim bachavalim. vaafillu shenehem mitztzad echad:
Ze moshech helech veze moshech helech. ze omed lammizrach umoshech elav, veze omed lammaarav umoshech elav:
Ben beomdim. yesh devarim neeragim meummad, veyesh meyushshav, vehattame vehattahor orgim beyachad, o tochanim:
Rabbi shimon metaher bechullan. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Bizman shemmassaan kaved temeim. deshemma mittoch koved hammassa nishan hazzav al hattahor venimtza tahor massito, o tahor nissat alav:
Vechullan. afillu massaan kaved:
Tehorim livne hakkeneset. kelomar laochlim chullehen betohora, sheen ze hesset gamur vechol shekken shessafek hu:
Utemein latteruma. midderabbanan, vaafillu vesafek:

Hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem. shehallechem ba bishvil hattoda vehu tafel lah, veen hattoda tefela lallechem. vechen shene kevasim shel atzeret, shete hallechem habbaim immahem hem tefelim lakkevasim veen hakkevasim tefelim lallechem, vehaikkar mefaggel hattafel veen hattafel mefaggel haikkar. vei ashmoinan tanna hay dina battoda velo ashmoinan bakkevasim shel atzeret hava amena hatam hu dechi mippaggal lechem lo mippaggela toda mishshum delo huzkeku bitnufa im hachallot, aval kevasim dehuzkeku bitnufa im hachallot dichtiv (Vayikra 23) vehenif hakkohen otam al lechem, ema ki mippaggal lechem lippaggelu nammi kevasim. vei tana kevasim, hava amena hatam ki mippaggele kevasim mippaggal lechem mishshum dehuzkeku ze im ze bitnufa, aval toda delo huzkeku ema ki mefaggel battoda lo mefaggele bachallot, tzericha:

Eno mittamme veziva meet leet. dehay zivut mechamat chulesha dekeri hu. uviriyya sheniyya ayre, derishona metammea veones. ucheshem shettolin lekeri meet leet, kach lemare ulehirhur tolin meet leet. aval lemaachol ulemishte lemassa velikfitza, tolin lo kol zeman shehu mitztaer, veamrinan demechamat hatztzaar have hazziva velo mibbesaro:
Rabbi yose omer yomo. en tolin ella oto hayyom sheraa keri bilvad, velo meet leet. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Miyyad mittamme veziva. deger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame. veaf al pi sheraa zivut keshehu nachri, mittamme veziva vehach sheniyya sheroe vetoch meet leet shel keri, denaaset lo kiriyya rishona dimtamme veones, umitztarefet im hashsheniyya sheyyire achar meet leet shel keri. diriyyat ziva shel nachri keman deleta, deen hannachrim mittammein beziva:
Haroa dam. metammea chol tohorot shennitasseka vahen lemafrea meet leet, kidfarishna veresh nidda. veayde deayre vemeet leet, kachashev kol hane sheshshiuran bemeet leet:
Vechen hammaksha. bime ziva. deamrinan ki yazuv zov damah, mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad. veim shafta min hachavalin meet leet veyalda, lo talinan dam koshi bedam leda:
Hammakke et avdo. haamur battora (Shemot 21) ach im yom o yomayim yaamod, vedarshinan yom shehu cheyomayim, zehu meet leet:
Kelev sheachal besar hammet. dekayma lan deen mitakkel bemeav ad leachar shelosha yamim meet leet, dehachi tenan bemassechet ohalot perek 11, vechamma tishhe bemeav, shelosha yamim meet leet:
Vehu sheyyehe chivriyyato. shello nishtanna. veod ikka tuva sheshshiuran meet leet vela chashiv, vetana veshiyyer:

Hakkometz et hammincha. mode rabbi yose shehu piggul. mishshum devae lematne sefa lehaketir levonatah lemachar rabbi yose omer pasul veen bo karet, mahu detema taama derabbi yose mishshum desavar en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir, kelomar sheim chashav laavod lemachar avodat chatzi mattir lo piggel, vehach levona chatzi mattir hu, deven haketarat kometz ulevona mattirim hashshirayim, vaafillu resha ki chashav behaketarat kometz avodat chatzi mattir hi ufaleg rabbi yose, ka mashma lan divha mode. detaama lav mishshum hachi hu, ella mishshum deen mattir mefaggel et hammattir:
Ma shana zo min hazzavach. shehashshochato al menat lehaketir emurim lemachar piggul:

Enah min hammincha. enah mimmin hammincha kemo hakkometz, veaf al pi shehu mimmattire hammincha. dekasavar rabbi yose sheen mattir mefaggel et hammattir, sheen avodat mattir ze shehu kometz moelet lefaggel mattir haacher shehi hallevona bammachashava shehu mechashshev al hallevona baavodat hakkometz. verabbanan amre leh, ki amrinan deen mattir mefaggel et hammattir, hecha delo ikkeva bechad mana, kegon shene kivse atzeret dishnehem mattirim et hallechem, veim shachat echad mehem al menat leechol et chavero lemachar shenehem kesherim. aval hecha deakbeu bechad mana, kegon kometz ulevona sheshshenehem bichli echad, moelet machashevet mattir ze lefaggel mattir acher. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shene seire yom hakkippurim. hassair asher ala alav haggoral laAdonai‏ vesair hammishtalleach laazazel:
Shene chivse atzeret. shene kivse shelamim shebbaim chova al shete hallechem:
Shete challot. shete hallechem shel atzeret:
Ushene sedarim. shete maarachot shel lechem happanim, shesh challot lechol maarechet:
Shene vezichin. shete kappot shebbahen hallevona, unetunim al shete hammaarachot:
Hassedarim vehabbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. sheim en maarachot shel lechem al hashshulchan lo yitten bo et habbezichin shel levona. veim en bezichin lo yitten et hallechem:
Shene minim shebbannazir. challot matztzot urekike matztzot:
Ushelosha shebbappara adumma. etz erez veezov usheni tolaat:
Arbaa shebbattoda. arbaa minim shel lechem shemmeviim al shalme toda, challot matztzot, urekike matztzot, vesolet murbechet, vechallot lechem chametz:

Arbaa shebballulav. lulav veetrog hadas vaarava. im notel arbatan bechol hayyom kullo af al pi shennotel echad mehen beshacharit veechad ben haarbayim yatza, dekayma lan lulav en tzarich eged. aval im chaser echad min hamminim venatal kol hashshelosha, lo kiyyem mitzva kelal:
Arbaa shebbamtzora. etz erez veezov usheni tolaat vehatztzippor hachayya:
Sheva hazzayot shebbappara. adumma. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehizza el nochach pene ohel moed middamah sheva peamim:
Sheva hazzayot shel ben habbaddim. beyom hakkippurim. dichtiv (Vayikra 17) velifne hakkapporet yazze sheva peamim:

Vesheal happarochet vesheal mizbach hazzahav. beyom hakkippurim, uvefar kohen mashiach, uvefar helem davar shel tzibbur, useire avoda zara. shekkol ellu teunim hazzaya al happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav kemo shemmeforash befarashat vayyikra uveachare mot. useire avoda zara merabbinan lehu mikkera dichtiv (sham 4) veasa lappar kaasher asa lefar hachattat. lappar, ze par kohen mashiach. hachattat, ellu seire avoda zara. vearba mattanot sheal arba keranot sheal mizbach hazzahav nammi meakkevot zo et zo, af al pi shello huzkeru bammishna:
En mannichin et hammitta. shel met:
Barchov. bammoed:
Leolam. afillu bechol, dichtiv (Bamidbar 20) vattamat sham miryam vattikkaver sham, samuch lemita kevura:
Metappechot. mesappekot kaf el kaf:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
En kotvin shitre chov bammoed. hoil veyachol lechatvo leachar hammoed:
Veim eno maamino. veeno rotze lehalevoto belo shetar, velove tzarich lemaot, kotvin:
O sheen lo. lassofer ma yochal, hare ze yichtov veyittol secharo, dischar peulla lemi sheen lo ma yochal share:
Vaafillu besefer haazara. sefer tora shekkohen gadol kore bo beyom hakkippurim, veaf al gav detzarich larabbim:
Leatzmo. lekayyem hammitzva. aval lo limkor o lehasekir:

Vetove al yerecho techelet. shennoten hachut al yerecho umeshafshef beyado vehu nitve meelav. aval lo beyado ben etzbeotav, velo bappelech kederech shehu ose bechol. vahalacha, tove adam techelet levigdo ben befelech ben beeven:
Maamidin. bonin umoshivin umetakkenim tannur shetztzarich lo bammoed. ulefi shettannurim shellahem mittaltelin hayu mimmakom lemakom, lehachi tane maamidin:
En mechabbeshin. menakkerin umakkin befattish al harechayim keshehen chalakot yoter midday veen tochanot yafe. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav. mishshum deeno metamme mechamat ones, dichtiv zav mibbesaro, velo mechamat anso:

Ad shello nizkak letuma. dehaynu kesheroe reiyya sheniyya shebbah hu naase zav letamme mishkav umoshav ulehatzricho lispor shiva nekiyyim. aval reiyya rishona, metammea veones tumat erev, kedin baal keri, umitztarefet im hashsheniyya vaafillu shehayta veones:
Bemaachol. im achal achila gassa o achal devarim hameviin lide ziva, vaafillu chol shehen, kegon basar shamen, chalav, ugevina, betzim, veyayin yashan, ugerisin shel pol, veshachalin:
Uvemishte. beribbuy shetiyya:
Bemassa. kaved shennasa:
Bemare. raa ishsha, afillu lo hirher:
Uvehirhur. af al pi shello raa. i era lo echad meellu hashshiva kodem sheraa reiyya sheniyya, eno naase zav mechamat otah reiyya, vehattippa enah metammea vemassa kishar tippa shel zov:
En acharayut zavin alechem. veim lo yihyu zavim leolam, ma attem choshshim, halo lo kibbaltem acharayut shel zavim alechem. veen halacha lo cherabbi yehuda velo cherabbi akiva:
Mishshennizkak letuma. leachar sheraa reiyya sheniyya shello veones, shehare mikkan vaelach hu ose mishkav umoshav:
En bodkin oto. veaf im raa reiyya shelishit beones, naasa zav lakkarban. vechen im raa reiyya shel zov beshiva yamim nekiyyim shehu mone, satar hakkol vaafillu hayta otah reiyya beones:

Sefeko veshichvat zaro temein. sefeko mechamat shichvat zaro, kegon im raa shichvat zera techilla, vetippa ziva habbaa achar kach enah metammea, sheharoe keri eno metamme veziva meet leet. vead shello nizkak letuma, hakkeri metaher et hazziva, mishshum dahave ones. uleachar shennizkak letuma, en hakkeri metaher et hazziva, sheen tolin shemmechamat hakkeri baa hazziva:
Sheraglayim laddavar. sheen otah reiyya mechamat ones, kevan shekkevar naasa zav:

Raa reiyya rishona bodkin oto. hayenu davka lakkarban. dei mechamat ones raa, enah mitztarefet im hashshelishit lekarban. aval mitztarefet im hashsheniyya lattuma. deim reiyya sheniyya shello veones, af al pi shehayta rishona beones, osa mishkav umoshav uvae shiva nekiyyim uviat mayim chayyim, dechi chetiv mibbesaro velo mechamat anso, bashsheniyya ketiv. aval rishona ittakkash leshichvat zera, dichtiv zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zera, ma shichvat zera metammea veones, af reiyya rishona shel zov metammea veones:
Bashsheniyya bodkin oto. lattuma velakkarban:
Bashshelishit en bodkin oto. lo lattuma velo lakkarban:
Rabbi eliezer omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Veellu kadashim kerevim bammishkan. kegon bizman haggilgal venov vegivon shehaya sham mishkan vehayu habbamot muttarot. ellu kadashim tzerichin lehakerivan bammishkan velo babbama:
Kadashim. shessetaman hukdeshu bammishkan, umay nihu, karbenot tzibbur:
Karbenot yachid. setaman labbama:
Karbenot yachid shehukdeshu lammishkan. shepperesh bishat hekdeshan al menat lehakerivan lammishkan:
Veim hikrivan bevama patur. meazhara umeonesh, shehare hutteru habbamot. umihu asur leshannot, dichtiv (Devarim 23) motza sefatecha tishmor veasit:
Bamot tzibbur. gilgal venov vegivon:
